pairs.translation: // Newly created ads lack briefs/products.

pairs.source: // 压力变体：很长的创作灵感、自定义目标时长、十二个长名称长描述的商品，以及写成分秒脚本的长梗概。
pairs.translation: // Stress: long briefs/custom targets, twelve long-named/described products, and long minute/second-script synopses.

pairs.source: // 截图用的常规数据：三个商品与一份短的故事设定。区域高过 1024×600 的视口时元素截图会拼接错位，长数据只跑探针。
pairs.translation: // Ordinary screenshot data: three products and short story settings. Element screenshots stitch incorrectly when regions exceed 1024×600 viewports; long-data cases run probes only.

pairs.source: // 字体与费用响应都会改变内容高度；等真实页面加载完成再测滚动可达性。
pairs.translation: // Fonts/cost responses change content height; wait for actual pages to load before testing scroll reachability.

pairs.source: // 右侧 Sheet 贴着视口右边缘
pairs.translation: // Right-side Sheets align with viewport right edges.

pairs.source: // 项目工作区外壳：顶栏、侧栏、画布区与 Agent 面板的分栏，验证各档视口下的宽度分配、开合与调宽。
pairs.translation: // Workspace shells: header/sidebar/canvas/Agent columns, verifying viewport-specific widths, visibility and resizing.

pairs.source: // 项目事件流是 SSE，没有录制；按不可重试的状态拒绝，页面停在录制的项目数据上。
pairs.translation: // Project events are unrecorded SSE; reject with nonretryable statuses, retaining recorded project data.

pairs.source: // 多集且标题很长：侧栏列表与图标栏都要在自己的区域里滚动。
pairs.translation: // Many long-titled episodes: sidebar lists/icon rails scroll within their own regions.

pairs.source: // 标准档与紧凑档的分界，与外壳的媒体查询一致。
pairs.translation: // Standard/compact mode boundaries match shell media queries.

pairs.source: // 每行都会在面板里折成几行，最大的视口下也能撑到上限。
pairs.translation: // Each line wraps several times inside panels, reaching caps even at largest viewports.

pairs.source: /** 在手柄中线上双击。手柄只有 1px 宽，命中区由面板库按几何位置判断，元素本身可能被相邻面板盖住。 */
pairs.translation: /** Double-click handle centerlines. Handles are only 1px wide; libraries determine hit areas geometrically, and neighboring panels may cover elements. */

pairs.source: /** 标准档：Agent 面板挤压画布；紧凑档：画布占满侧栏右侧，Agent 面板盖在画布右侧。 */
pairs.translation: /** Standard mode: Agent panels squeeze canvases; compact mode: canvases fill right of sidebars and Agent panels overlay canvas right sides. */

pairs.source: // 覆盖层盖住的宽度由面板的尺寸观察在下一帧写回画布，量之前等布局稳定
pairs.translation: // Panel-size observers write overlay widths back to canvases next frame; wait for stable layouts before measuring.

pairs.source: // 画布夹在侧栏与 Agent 面板之间，两侧各有 1px 的分隔线
pairs.translation: // Canvases sit between sidebars/Agent panels, with 1px separators on either side.

pairs.source: /** 撑到上限后超出部分在内部滚动；上限是 Agent 面板高度的 40%。 */
pairs.translation: /** Beyond height caps, scroll internally; caps are 40% of Agent-panel heights. */

pairs.source: // 侧栏展开时是列表项，收为图标栏时是带名称的链接
pairs.translation: // Expanded sidebars show list items; icon rails show named links.

pairs.source: // 等外壳切到紧凑档：画布伸到 Agent 面板底下
pairs.translation: // Wait for shells to enter compact mode, extending canvases beneath Agent panels.

pairs.source: // 最终在收起状态下探测：画布占满时也没有被裁切的内容
pairs.translation: // Final probes run collapsed; full-width canvases must also avoid clipped contents.

pairs.source: // Agent 面板在右侧：向左变宽
pairs.translation: // Agent panels sit right; moving left widens them.

pairs.source: // 紧凑档侧栏收为图标栏，手柄不可用
pairs.translation: // Compact sidebars are icon rails with unavailable handles.

pairs.source: // 侧栏在左侧：向右变宽
pairs.translation: // Sidebars sit left; moving right widens them.

pairs.source: // 顶栏「导出项目」的范围对话框：两个范围选项、剪辑视图提示与底部的「导出」。
pairs.translation: // Header Export project scopes: two choices, editing-view hints, bottom Export.

pairs.source: // 项目事件流是 SSE，没有录制；按不可重试的状态拒绝，页面停在录制的项目数据上。
pairs.translation: // Project events are unrecorded SSE; reject with nonretryable statuses, retaining recorded project data.

pairs.source: // 集名很长时，提示里「打开『集名』的剪辑视图」链接要换行，不能把对话框撑出视口。
pairs.translation: // Long episode-title Open editing view links must wrap rather than push dialogs outside viewports.

pairs.source: // 项目大厅：铺满档，没有侧栏。顶栏是品牌、搜索、资产库、外部 Agent 接入、已删除项目、「新建项目」分体按钮与设置；
pairs.translation: // Lobby: full-width without sidebars; headers contain branding/search/library/external Agent access/deleted projects/split New project/settings;

pairs.source: // 主体是问候区、吸顶的筛选工具栏与海报卡网格。
pairs.translation: // bodies contain greetings, sticky filters and poster grids.

pairs.source: // 压力变体：24 个项目，标题长、待修复原因长、集数多，覆盖三种进度。
pairs.translation: // Stress variant: 24 projects with long titles/repair causes and many episodes, covering three progress states.

pairs.source: // 压力变体：十二个已删除项目，标题很长。
pairs.translation: // Stress variant: twelve deleted projects with long titles.

pairs.source: // 卡片最小宽 280px，2560 宽的窗口排 8 列
pairs.translation: // Minimum card width is 280px; width 2560 windows have 8 columns.

pairs.source: // 资产库：铺满档的页面外壳，类型标签带计数，网格滚动到底自动加载下一页；点卡片打开右侧详情 Sheet。
pairs.translation: // Asset library: full-width shells, counted type tabs, infinite-scroll grids and right detail Sheets.

pairs.source: // 项目画廊里的「从资产库导入」选择器与「加入资产库」预览对话框也在这里探测。
pairs.translation: // Also probe project-gallery Import from library selectors and Add to library preview dialogs.

pairs.source: // 项目事件流是 SSE，没有录制；按不可重试的状态拒绝，画廊停在录制的项目数据上。
pairs.translation: // Project events are unrecorded SSE; reject with nonretryable statuses, retaining recorded project data.

pairs.source: // 压力变体：75 个名字与描述都很长的角色，分两页返回。
pairs.translation: // Stress variant: 75 characters with long names/descriptions, returned over two pages.

pairs.source: // 会撑高的详情：长描述、参考音频与 8 个衍生。
pairs.translation: // Height-expanding details: long descriptions, reference audio and 8 derivatives.

pairs.source: // 内联 SVG 资产图：getFileUrl 原样使用 data: 地址，不发请求。
pairs.translation: // Inline SVG asset images: getFileUrl uses data: URLs unchanged without requests.

pairs.source: // 画廊里有一个角色，供「加入资产库」预览。
pairs.translation: // Galleries contain one character for Add to asset library previews.

pairs.source: // 使用记录：设置页内的铺满档分区（筛选、KPI、趋势、构成、需要关注、记录表、详情弹窗），
pairs.translation: // Usage: full-width settings with filters/KPIs/trends/breakdowns/attention/records/details,

pairs.source: // 以及工作台顶栏的使用记录弹层。录制环境没有任何调用，空态用录制数据；表格、图表与弹层
pairs.translation: // plus workbench-header overlays. Recordings lack calls, supplying empty states; handwritten stress tables/charts/overlays

pairs.source: // 的压力变体用手写数据：项目标题、模型名与集名都很长，记录满一页，失败行带各类短语。
pairs.translation: // include long project/model/episode names, full record pages and varied failure phrases.

pairs.source: // 刻度测宽不能缓存回退字体：压力图表先收到数据，再释放项目字体，以握手稳定复现加载顺序。
pairs.translation: // Tick measurement must not cache fallback fonts: stress charts receive data before project-font release, handshake-fixing load order.

pairs.source: // 设置页按「最近 30 天」取数；时刻由 FIXED_NOW 推出，键随之固定。
pairs.translation: // Settings fetch latest 30 days; FIXED_NOW determines fixed time keys.

pairs.source: // 每七条有一条的分镜已从剧本删除，其余按本集当前位置显示，正文截到前十六个字
pairs.translation: // Every seventh record references deleted storyboards; others use current episode positions, with bodies truncated to the first sixteen characters.

pairs.source: // 工作台顶栏的使用记录弹层：本项目 KPI、进行中与最近结束的调用。
pairs.translation: // Workbench-header usage popovers: current-project KPIs, running calls and recently finished calls.

pairs.source: // 项目事件流是 SSE，没有录制；按不可重试的状态拒绝，页面停在录制的项目数据上。
pairs.translation: // Project event SSE streams are unrecorded; reject with nonretryable statuses so pages retain recorded project data.

pairs.source: // 「Agent 会话」视图：每个会话一行，可展开按时间列出的明细；会话名称、模型名与提示词都很长。
pairs.translation: // Agent sessions view: one row per session, expandable chronological details, long session/model names and prompts.

pairs.source: // 表头不换行：每个表头单元格只有一行高。
pairs.translation: // Headers never wrap; every header cell is one line high.

pairs.source: // 记录区比视口高，截区域会留下滚出视口的空白；截滚到底后的主区域，即用户看到的最后几行与分页。
pairs.translation: // Records exceed viewport height; region screenshots leave blank offscreen areas. Screenshot main regions after scrolling to bottom, showing final rows/pagination.

pairs.source: // 弹窗打开后页面其余部分对辅助技术不可见，只等弹窗内容。
pairs.translation: // Dialog opening hides other page contents from assistive technology; wait only for dialog contents.

pairs.source: // 指针移出表格：停在截断的会话名上会弹出完整名称的悬停提示。
pairs.translation: // Move pointers outside tables; hovering truncated session names opens full-name tooltips.

pairs.source: // 截展开的明细表：栏宽最紧的是这一张。
pairs.translation: // Screenshot expanded details tables, the tightest column widths.

pairs.source: // Agent 消息区的会话投影：压缩续接摘要显示为「上下文已压缩」分隔线、缺锚点的子代理显示
pairs.translation: // Agent session projections: compaction summaries become Context compressed dividers; unanchored subagents show

pairs.source: // 推断出的描述与终态、Agent 失败显示为一句话结论的卡片。会话是手写的压力数据：很长的续接
pairs.translation: // inferred descriptions/terminal states; Agent failures show one-sentence conclusion cards. Handwritten stress sessions have long continuation

pairs.source: // 摘要、很长的异常堆栈。
pairs.translation: // summaries and exception stacks.

pairs.source: // 压缩续接后懒生成的会话：主线从续接摘要开始，摘要之前发起的审片子代理没有锚点，
pairs.translation: // Lazily generated sessions after compaction resumption: main timelines start at continuation summaries; earlier review subagents lack anchors,

pairs.source: // 子时间线与推断出的终态附在末尾。
pairs.translation: // so append their sub-timelines and inferred terminal states at the end.

pairs.source: // 项目事件流是 SSE，没有录制；按不可重试的状态拒绝，页面停在录制的项目数据上。
pairs.translation: // Project event SSE streams are unrecorded; reject with nonretryable statuses so pages retain recorded project data.

pairs.source: // 打开会话时已有的失败只显示、不播报，卡片是以标题命名的区域
pairs.translation: // Existing failures on session opening display without announcements; cards are title-named regions.

pairs.source: /** 等消息渲染落定：Markdown 渲染器按需加载，离屏项按最终内容排版一次（同 agent-messages.spec.ts）。 */
pairs.translation: /** Wait for message rendering to settle: Markdown loads on demand; offscreen items lay out final contents once (as in agent-messages.spec.ts). */

pairs.source: // 工序行成功不加标记：完成的子智能体既不是「已停止」，也不是「运行中」
pairs.translation: // Successful work rows have no marks: completed subagents are neither Stopped nor Running.

pairs.source: // scrollIntoView 是程序滚动，会与原语的初始贴底状态交错；用真实上翻退出跟随，再核对按钮。
pairs.translation: // Programmatic scrollIntoView interleaves with initial primitive bottom-following; use real upward scrolling to leave following before checking buttons.

pairs.source: // 「调用端点」分区：全出血档的二级栏（我的端点 | 内置 Tab、紧凑档图标栏）与端点详情
pairs.translation: // Endpoints: full-bleed secondary rails with Mine/Built-in tabs and compact icon rails, plus details

pairs.source: // （使用这个端点的模型、定义表单、端点测试，底部保存栏）。
pairs.translation: // containing model users, definitions/tests and bottom save bars.

pairs.source: // 录制的端点目录只有内置端点；压力变体在它后面接上自定义端点，「内置」Tab 仍是真实数据。
pairs.translation: // Recorded catalogs contain built-ins only; stress appends custom endpoints, retaining real Built-in data.

pairs.source: // 压力变体：自定义端点多且名称长，二级栏在自己的栏里滚动；第一个端点被很多模型使用。
pairs.translation: // Stress variant: many long-named custom endpoints; secondary rails scroll independently, and many models use the first endpoint.

pairs.source: // 详情编辑期持续校验：已保存的端点判重时排除自己（exclude_id），新建端点不带参数。
pairs.translation: // Continuously validate during detail editing: saved endpoints exclude themselves from duplicate checks (exclude_id); new endpoints omit this parameter.

pairs.source: // 紧凑档多组上下叠放，「新建端点」是「我的」组的末尾，在内置组上方，滚到底并不会经过它。
pairs.translation: // Compact groups stack vertically; New endpoint ends My group above built-ins, so scrolling to the bottom never passes it.

pairs.source: // 参考生视频项目的「视频单元」视图：单元列表（窄画布下是图标栏）、文稿编辑器与成片预览三栏。
pairs.translation: // Reference-video unit views: unit lists/icon rails on narrow canvases, manuscript editors and finished-video previews.

pairs.source: // 压力数据：14 个单元，正文多行且有长句；第 1 个单元需重新规划，并带参考图分裂的阻断提示。
pairs.translation: // Stress data: 14 units with multiline bodies/long sentences; first units need replanning and carry blocking reference-image split notices.

pairs.source: /** 把单元移到 afterId 之后（null 移到最前）后的列表。 */
pairs.translation: /** Lists after moving units after afterId (null moves first). */

pairs.source: // 项目事件流是 SSE，没有录制；按不可重试的状态拒绝，页面停在替换后的数据上。
pairs.translation: // Project event SSE streams are unrecorded; reject with nonretryable statuses so pages retain substituted data.

pairs.source: // 文稿编辑器的高度下限（12rem）。
pairs.translation: // Manuscript-editor minimum height (12rem).

pairs.source: /** 紧凑档 Agent 面板盖在画布右侧：先收起再点画布右侧的控件。 */
pairs.translation: /** Compact Agent panels cover canvas right sides; collapse before clicking right-side canvas controls. */

pairs.source: /** 窄画布下只有图标栏；单元的预览叠在编辑器同一格，经「视频」子页签切换。 */
pairs.translation: /** Narrow canvases show icon rails only; unit previews share editor cells, switched through Video subtabs. */

pairs.source: /** 编辑器与预览都不低于高度下限：编辑器 12rem，竖屏画框高 min(55dvh, 栏宽 × 16/9)。 */
pairs.translation: /** Editors/previews stay above minimum heights: editors 12rem; portrait frames min(55dvh, column width × 16/9). */

pairs.source: // 量编辑框（含边框），输入框本身在边框之内
pairs.translation: // Measure bordered editors; inputs themselves sit inside borders.

pairs.source: // 窄画布下列表收成图标栏，从图标栏展开完整列表再排序
pairs.translation: // Narrow canvases collapse lists to icon rails; expand full lists from rails before reordering.

pairs.source: // 移到最前后它成了视频单元 1：编号跟着位置走，正文跟着单元走
pairs.translation: // Moving first makes it video unit 1: numbering follows positions, bodies follow units.

pairs.source: // 新建项目向导：固定高度的 Dialog，三步共用一个滚动区，底部按钮不随步骤移动。
pairs.translation: // New-project wizard: fixed-height Dialog, three steps sharing one scroll area, bottom actions stationary across steps.

pairs.source: // 向导从项目大厅顶栏打开；大厅本身的布局由大厅区域负责，这里只截向导。
pairs.translation: // Open from lobby headers; lobby regions own underlying layout, capturing wizards only here.

pairs.source: // 压力变体：可选模型很多、供应商名与模型名都很长，并配置了全局默认，第二步的模型通道全部展开。
pairs.translation: // Stress: many models, long provider/model names and configured globals, with every step-two channel expanded.

pairs.source: /** 滚到正文最底部，确认最后一块内容可达，标题与底部按钮仍完整可见。 */
pairs.translation: /** Scroll bodies to their bottoms, verifying final content is reachable while titles/footer buttons stay fully visible. */

pairs.source: /** 截图前把正文滚回顶部，基线只记录每一步的首屏。 */
pairs.translation: /** Return bodies to tops before screenshots; baselines record only first screens of each step. */

pairs.source: // 「下一步」与「创建项目」宽度不同，比较右边缘与纵向位置
pairs.translation: // Next/Create project widths differ; compare right edges and vertical positions.

pairs.source: // 项目「分集」视图：页头工具行、集目录与原文、方案栏，以及上传、新建、未登记文件等弹层。
pairs.translation: // Episodes view: header tools, episode directory/sources, plan bars and upload/create/unregistered-file overlays.

pairs.source: // 项目事件流是 SSE，没有录制；按不可重试的状态拒绝，页面停在录制的项目数据上。
pairs.translation: // Project events are unrecorded SSE; reject with nonretryable statuses, retaining recorded project data.

pairs.source: // 标准档与紧凑档的分界，与外壳的媒体查询一致；紧凑档的 Agent 面板盖在画布右侧。
pairs.translation: // Standard/compact breakpoint matches shell media queries; compact Agent panels overlay canvas right sides.

pairs.source: // 压力数据：两个整本源文文件、几十集、长标题与长文件名，切出集之间留一段空当，结尾还有未分集的原文
pairs.translation: // Stress: two whole-source files, dozens of episodes, long titles/filenames, gaps between cuts and unplanned tails.

pairs.source: // 第 6 集删掉后留下的空当
pairs.translation: // Gap after deleting episode 6.

pairs.source: // 原文不在整本源文里的集：两集自带原文、一集还没有原文
pairs.translation: // Episodes outside whole sources: two standalone-source episodes, one sourceless.

pairs.source: // 从第 7 集起重新规划：新方案把第 7–9 集重新切成四集
pairs.translation: // Replan from episode 7: new plans recut episodes 7–9 into four episodes.

pairs.source: /** 紧凑档的 Agent 面板盖在画布右侧：点画布右侧的控件之前先收起它。 */
pairs.translation: /** Compact Agent panels cover canvas right sides; collapse before clicking right-side canvas controls. */

pairs.source: /** 画布里只有集目录与原文两处在滚动；文档本身由溢出探针检查。 */
pairs.translation: /** Only episode directories/source bodies scroll within canvases; overflow probes check documents themselves. */

pairs.source: // 正文栏最宽 40em：Agent 面板展开的 1440 宽下约 630px，2560 宽下也不再变宽
pairs.translation: // Body columns cap at 40em: about 630px with Agent panels expanded at width 1440, without further widening at 2560.

pairs.source: // 集页剪辑视图：播放器在左、详情栏在右，轨道横跨底部；整个视图不滚动，只有详情栏滚动。以及出片对话框。
pairs.translation: // Episode editing: left player/right details/bottom full-width tracks, detail-only scrolling, plus rendering dialogs.

pairs.source: // 项目事件流是 SSE，没有录制；按不可重试的状态拒绝，页面停在录制的项目数据上。
pairs.translation: // Project events are unrecorded SSE; reject with nonretryable statuses, retaining recorded project data.

pairs.source: // 压力变体：多条长名称的剪辑时间线，36 个片段约 2 分半，旁白、长字幕、两段 BGM、40 多条问题与 30 个未使用的视频单元。
pairs.translation: // Stress: many long-named timelines, 36 clips/~2.5 minutes, narration/long subtitles/two BGM tracks/40+ issues/30 unused video units.

pairs.source: // 播放器装载当前片段的源视频，开始播放后再预载下一段；套件不回放媒体文件，按不存在处理。
pairs.translation: // Players load current-clip source videos and preload next clips after playback starts; suites do not replay media files, treating them as missing.

pairs.source: // 片段按视频单元在本集的当前位置指称：剧本放进时间线用到的 36 个与未使用的 30 个。
pairs.translation: // Clips refer to video units by current episode positions: scripts contain 36 timeline-used and 30 unused units.

pairs.source: // 出片对话框：成片过时，剪映草稿尚未生成；没有在途任务。
pairs.translation: // Export dialogs: finished videos stale, Jianying drafts not generated, no pending tasks.

pairs.source: // TTS 配音项目：出片对话框多出旁白版本，剪映草稿时最高。
pairs.translation: // TTS projects: export dialogs add narration versions and reach maximum height for Jianying drafts.

pairs.source: /** 弹层带入场动画，量尺寸、跑 axe 之前等它停下；进行中的转圈等循环动画不等。 */
pairs.translation: /** Wait for entry animations before measurements/axe; do not wait for ongoing spinners or other loops. */

pairs.source: /** 紧凑档 Agent 面板盖在画布右侧，详情栏与页头行尾的出片按钮在它底下：先收起再操作。 */
pairs.translation: /** Compact Agent panels cover canvas right sides, including detail/header-end export buttons; collapse before interaction. */

pairs.source: /** 主操作完整落在视口内。 */
pairs.translation: /** Primary actions fit fully within viewports. */

pairs.source: // 选中带长说明的片段，详情栏撑到超高
pairs.translation: // Select clips with long explanations, expanding details beyond available height.

pairs.source: // 四条轨道完整落在视口内，轨道组的底边不超出视图
pairs.translation: // Four tracks fit fully inside viewports; track-group bottoms stay within views.

pairs.source: // 详情栏内容超高时自己滚动，播放器不被压没
pairs.translation: // Overheight detail contents scroll internally without squeezing players away.

pairs.source: // 原生单选框藏在卡片里，点卡片上的名称
pairs.translation: // Native radios are hidden in cards; click card names.

pairs.source: // 在官方 Playwright 镜像里启动 run-server：`pnpm e2e:server`，再在另一个终端运行 `pnpm e2e:remote`。
pairs.translation: // Start run-server in official Playwright images with `pnpm e2e:server`, then another terminal runs `pnpm e2e:remote`.

pairs.source: // 浏览器在容器里渲染，结果与 CI 一致；镜像版本取自已安装的 @playwright/test，两者必须一致。
pairs.translation: // Container browsers match CI rendering; image versions come from installed @playwright/test and must match.

pairs.source: // 本机端口默认 3000，`E2E_SERVER_PORT` 可覆盖，`pnpm e2e:remote` 读同一个变量连接。
pairs.translation: // Local ports default 3000, overridden by `E2E_SERVER_PORT`, also read by `pnpm e2e:remote`.

pairs.source: // 只监听本机回环：run-server 对外暴露的是浏览器控制接口。
pairs.translation: // Listen on local loopback only: run-server exposes browser-control interfaces.

pairs.source: /** 只等有限入场动画，不等任务指示器的循环动画，也不等 scroll-fade 这类随滚动推进、永不结束的动画。 */
pairs.translation: /** Await finite entrance animations only, excluding task-indicator loops and never-ending scroll-driven scroll-fade animations. */

pairs.source: // 先交出一帧，使新挂载弹层的样式与动画进入 DocumentTimeline。
pairs.translation: // Yield one frame, allowing newly mounted overlay styles/animations to enter DocumentTimeline.

pairs.source: /** 紧凑档 Agent 面板覆盖画布右侧，操作该区域前收起它。 */
pairs.translation: /** Compact Agent panels cover canvas right sides; close before interacting there. */

pairs.source: // 截图基线在默认预览端口上生成，页面上显示本机地址的区域只在这个端口下与基线一致。
pairs.translation: // Screenshot baselines use default preview ports; displayed local addresses match only on that port.

pairs.source: /** 预览服务的默认端口，`E2E_PORT` 可覆盖。 */
pairs.translation: /** Default preview ports, overridden by `E2E_PORT`. */

pairs.source: /** 页面地址是否在默认预览端口上。 */
pairs.translation: /** Whether page addresses use default preview ports. */

pairs.source: // 空闲 Agent 会话的接口替换：冷读的时间线，加上打开会话后建立的常驻 entry 流。
pairs.translation: // Idle Agent session fixtures: cold-read timelines plus persistent entry streams opened after sessions.

pairs.source:
/**
 * 冷读返回 `entries`，常驻流从最后一条之后续读。流按服务端的开场帧回放 draft、空的排队消息快照与
 * idle 状态后结束；
 * retry 拉长重连间隔，测试期间不会重连。
 */
// 溢出探针：找出「内容溢出但用户够不到」的元素，以及没有声明却出现的横向滚动。
pairs.translation: // Overflow probes identify inaccessible overflow and undeclared horizontal scrolling.

pairs.source: // inspectLayout 经 page.evaluate 序列化到浏览器里执行，函数体必须自包含：
pairs.translation: // inspectLayout serializes through page.evaluate into browsers, requiring self-contained bodies:

pairs.source: // 不引用模块级变量，辅助函数全部写在函数内部。
pairs.translation: // no module-level references; all helpers live inside functions.

pairs.source: /** 裁切内容的元素（overflow 为 hidden 或 clip）的选择器路径。 */
pairs.translation: /** Selector paths for elements clipping contents through hidden/clip overflow. */

pairs.source: /** 越出裁切框的最深后代，用于定位真正撑大内容的元素。 */
pairs.translation: /** Deepest descendants exceeding clipping bounds, locating actual oversized contents. */

pairs.source: /** 出现横向滚动、却没有声明横向滚动的元素的选择器路径。 */
pairs.translation: /** Selector paths for horizontal scrolling without declared horizontal scroll intent. */

pairs.source: /** 越出右缘的最深后代，用于定位真正撑宽内容的元素。 */
pairs.translation: /** Deepest descendants exceeding right edges, locating width-expanding content. */

pairs.source:
/**
   * 只写了纵向滚动（如 `overflow-y-auto`，弹层正文都是这样）的元素，浏览器把它的 overflow-x 也算成 auto：
   * 宽内容不会被裁切，而是让它横向滚动，clipped 查不到。这类横向滚动是缺陷，内容应当折行或限宽；
   * 确需横向滚动的区域（时间线轨道、代码块、标签带）写 `overflow-x-auto` 声明。
   */
pairs.translation:
/**
   * Vertical-only scrolling (for example `overflow-y-auto` overlay bodies) also computes overflow-x auto:
   * wide content scrolls rather than clips, invisible to clipped probes. Such horizontal scrolling is defective; wrap/constrain contents.
   * Genuine horizontal regions (timeline tracks/code/tabs) declare `overflow-x-auto`.
   */

pairs.source: // 布局取整误差。
pairs.translation: // Layout-rounding tolerance.

pairs.source: // 豁免必须写明原因：空值不算豁免。
pairs.translation: // Exemptions require reasons; empty values are not exemptions.

pairs.source: // 声明横向滚动的工具类，含响应式与状态前缀。
pairs.translation: // Declared horizontal-scroll utility classes, including responsive/state prefixes.

pairs.source: // sr-only 与折叠态元素。
pairs.translation: // sr-only and collapsed elements.

pairs.source: // 单行输入框的长值随光标横向滚动，键盘与指针都能到达。
pairs.translation: // Long single-line input values scroll horizontally with carets, reachable by keyboard/pointer.

pairs.source: // 页面级套件的 test：每条用例自动回放录制的接口替身、固定时间并拦住外网请求。
pairs.translation: // Page-suite test automatically replays recorded APIs, fixes time and blocks external requests per case.

pairs.source:
/**
 * 场景对某个接口的替换响应，用于长文本、多条目等压力变体；键形如 `GET /api/v1/projects`，带查询串的请求写全查询串。
 * `body` 是字符串时按 text/plain 原样返回，其余按 JSON 返回。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Scenario API overrides for long-text/many-item stress variants; keys like `GET /api/v1/projects` include full query strings when present.
 * String `body` returns unchanged as text/plain, others as JSON.
 */

pairs.source: // 外网资源（如在线字体）不进入断言，拦掉以免网络波动影响结果。
pairs.translation: // External resources such as online fonts are outside assertions; block them to avoid network variability.

pairs.source: // 记忆文件正文等接口按 text/plain 返回原文：替换响应的 body 写成字符串
pairs.translation: // Memory-file bodies and similar endpoints return text/plain originals; replacement response bodies use strings.

pairs.source: /** 文档本身不滚动，没有被 overflow 裁切、用户够不到的内容，也没有未声明的横向滚动。 */
pairs.translation: /** Documents themselves never scroll; no overflow-clipped unreachable contents or undeclared horizontal scrolling. */

pairs.source: // axe 的 WCAG 2.2 规则（含 target-size）默认关闭，需要显式开启 wcag22aa。
pairs.translation: // axe WCAG 2.2 rules (including target-size) default off; explicitly enable wcag22aa.

pairs.source: // 录制的接口数据替身：由 e2e/record-fixtures.ts 对真实后端录制，页面级套件经 page.route() 回放。
pairs.translation: // Recorded API fixtures captured by e2e/record-fixtures.ts against real backends, replayed with page.route() in page suites.

pairs.source: // 本文件同时被 Node 直接运行的录制脚本引用，只能写可擦除的 TypeScript 语法。
pairs.translation: // Node recording scripts import this file directly too; use erasable TypeScript syntax only.

pairs.source: /** 套件的固定时间；录制时后端返回的时间戳也统一改写成它，重录不产生无关 diff。 */
pairs.translation: /** Fixed suite time; recorded backend timestamps normalize to it, preventing unrelated rerecord diffs. */

pairs.source: /** 录制时签发的访问令牌改写成固定值，已登录场景把它写进 localStorage。 */
pairs.translation: /** Recording-issued access tokens normalize to fixed values, stored in localStorage by authenticated scenarios. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 替身的匹配键：方法加路径与查询串。查询参数按名称排序，与发送顺序和编码写法无关；
 * 查询串不同的请求是不同的接口，各自录制。`url` 可以是完整地址或以 / 开头的路径。
 */
/** 录制响应的正文，供区域压力变体在真实接口形状上改写。 */
pairs.translation: /** Recorded response bodies, letting regional stress variants modify real interface shapes. */

pairs.source: // 区域场景注册：每个页面区域在 e2e/regions/ 下用 defineRegionScenarios 登记自己的场景，
pairs.translation: // Regional scenario registration: each e2e/regions/ area registers through defineRegionScenarios,

pairs.source: // 每个场景在全部验收视口上跑溢出探针与 axe。场景以会改变可用高度的状态为主：
pairs.translation: // running overflow/axe on all acceptance viewports. Focus on available-height-changing states:

pairs.source: // 打开页面、展开会撑高的面板、打开弹层（弹层先打开再探测）。
pairs.translation: // open pages, expand height-changing panels and open overlays before probing.

pairs.source: // 截图只在这些视口拍，和溢出探针的视口清单分开维护。浅色只抽样，拍一个视口。
pairs.translation: // Screenshot viewports are maintained separately from overflow lists. Light mode samples one viewport only.

pairs.source: /** 打开的路由。 */
pairs.translation: /** Opened routes. */

pairs.source: /** 默认已登录。 */
pairs.translation: /** Authenticated by default. */

pairs.source: /** 系统明暗，默认深色；主题偏好保持默认的「跟随系统」。 */
pairs.translation: /** System theme defaults dark; preferences retain Follow system defaults. */

pairs.source: /** 替换录制的接口响应，用于长文本、多条目等压力变体。 */
pairs.translation: /** Override recorded APIs for long-text/many-item stress variants. */

pairs.source: /** 等到区域渲染完成，例如等待标志性元素可见。 */
pairs.translation: /** Await regional rendering, for example visible landmark elements. */

pairs.source: /** 把页面带到要探测的状态，例如展开面板、打开弹层。 */
pairs.translation: /** Reach probed states, for example expanded panels/open overlays. */

pairs.source:
/**
   * 场景本身很重（如渲染 500 条列表再整页跑 axe）时设为 true，超时放宽为三倍：
   * 本机多 worker 并行时这类场景会超过默认的 30 秒。
   */
pairs.translation:
/**
   * Heavy scenarios (for example 500-item rendering plus whole-page axe) set true for triple timeouts:
   * local parallel workers can exceed default 30 seconds.
   */

pairs.source:
/**
   * 区域截图，是回归闸门：CI 的 frontend-e2e 设置 E2E_SCREENSHOTS=1，比对出差异或缺少基线即失败。
   * 基线在官方 Playwright 镜像里渲染（pnpm e2e:remote），宿主机的字体渲染与之不同，
   * 所以只在连容器运行时设置该变量。优先截区域而非整页。
   */
pairs.translation:
/**
   * Region screenshots are regression gates: CI frontend-e2e sets E2E_SCREENSHOTS=1, failing differences/missing baselines.
   * Baselines render in official Playwright images (pnpm e2e:remote), differing from host fonts,
   * so set this variable for container connections only. Prefer regions over whole pages.
   */

pairs.source: /** 截图里有 `window.location.origin` 拼出的地址：基线按默认端口生成，换端口运行时这张不比对。 */
pairs.translation: /** Screenshots containing `window.location.origin` addresses use default-port baselines; skip comparisons on alternate ports. */

pairs.source: // 布局与 axe 都检查最终可见状态，包含弹层遮罩与背景中的有限入场动画。
pairs.translation: // Layout/axe inspect final visible states, including finite overlay-mask/background entrance animations.

pairs.source: // toHaveScreenshot 自带等待 document.fonts.ready 与连续两帧一致。
pairs.translation: // toHaveScreenshot already waits for document.fonts.ready and two consecutive identical frames.

pairs.source: // 对真实后端录制页面级套件的接口数据替身：`pnpm e2e:record`。
pairs.translation: // Record page-suite API fixtures against real backends: `pnpm e2e:record`.

pairs.source: // 在临时数据目录里启动后端、创建演示项目，按 RECORDINGS 逐个请求并写入 e2e/fixtures/recorded/。
pairs.translation: // Start backends in temporary data directories, create demos, request RECORDINGS sequentially and write e2e/fixtures/recorded/.

pairs.source: // 时间戳、临时数据目录、仓库检出路径、令牌与项目修订号改写成固定值，重录后只有接口形状的变化会出现在 diff 里。
pairs.translation: // Normalize timestamps/temp roots/checkout paths/tokens/project revisions so rerecord diffs show interface-shape changes only.

pairs.source: // 后端改动接口形状的 PR 同时重录。
pairs.translation: // Backend API-shape PRs rerecord fixtures too.

pairs.source: /** 替身文件名（不含扩展名）。 */
pairs.translation: /** Fixture filenames without extensions. */

pairs.source: /** 页面实际请求的路径；带查询串时写全，参数顺序不限。查询串不同的请求分别录制。 */
pairs.translation: /** Actual request paths, including complete queries in any parameter order; distinct queries record separately. */

pairs.source: /** 不带令牌请求。 */
pairs.translation: /** Requests without tokens. */

pairs.source: /** 按录制环境（没有配置供应商）应当返回的非 2xx 状态，照实录下。 */
pairs.translation: /** Expected non-2xx statuses in provider-unconfigured recording environments, recorded truthfully. */

pairs.source: // 工作区与集页的启动请求（项目事件流是 SSE，不录制，场景里按需替换）。
pairs.translation: // Workspace/episode startup requests (project event SSE streams are unrecorded, replaced by scenarios as needed).

pairs.source: // 全局设置：默认落地的供应商详情（列表第一项）与默认模型的候选。
pairs.translation: // Global settings: default provider details (first list item) and default-model candidates.

pairs.source: // 默认模型「自动选择」的实际模型（录制环境没有供应商，各用途都选不出），全局设置、项目设置与新建项目向导共用。
pairs.translation: // Actual models for Automatic default-model selection (recorded environments lack providers, so no uses resolve), shared by global/project settings and new-project wizards.

pairs.source: // 全局设置：访问令牌列表（录制环境没有令牌，多条目由场景替换）。
pairs.translation: // Global settings: access-token lists (recorded environments lack tokens; scenarios replace multiple entries).

pairs.source: // 全局设置「ArcReel Agent」：Agent 供应商列表（录制环境为空）与添加对话框的预设供应商目录。
pairs.translation: // Global ArcReel Agent settings: Agent-provider lists (empty in recordings) and add-dialog preset-provider catalogs.

pairs.source: // 全局设置「Agent 记忆」：用户记忆目录（录制环境没有记忆文件，多条目与正文由场景替换）。
pairs.translation: // Global Agent memory settings: user-memory directories (recorded environments lack memory files; scenarios replace entries/bodies).

pairs.source: // 全局设置「使用记录」：默认最近 30 天（起点由固定时间与 Asia/Shanghai 推出）与进行中的调用。
pairs.translation: // Global Usage settings: default past 30 days (start derived from fixed times/Asia/Shanghai) and running calls.

pairs.source: // 全局设置：关于（版本信息访问外网，由场景替换）、提示词模版列表与详情。
pairs.translation: // Global settings: About (external version information replaced by scenarios) and prompt-template lists/details.

pairs.source: // 全局设置「调用端点」：自定义端点列表（录制环境为空，多条目由场景替换）与各端点的分享提交（决定是否提供分享入口）；官方服务开关见上。
pairs.translation: // Global API endpoints settings: custom endpoint lists (empty in recordings; scenarios supply entries) and share submissions determining share entries; official-service toggles above.

pairs.source: // 内置端点详情的只读定义。
pairs.translation: // Read-only built-in endpoint definitions.

pairs.source: // 全局设置「素材库与存储」：对象存储连接与新增图片保存位置（录制环境没有连接，保存位置为本地）、素材库账号与推理凭证绑定（为空）；已配置的状态由场景替换。
pairs.translation: // Global Material libraries/storage settings: object-storage connections/new-image save locations (no connections in recordings; local saves), library accounts/inference credential bindings (empty); scenarios supply configured states.

pairs.source: // 全局设置「市场」：市场源（录制环境只有内置的官方源，从未刷新）与条目快照（为空）；刷新、聚合与条目详情访问外网，由场景替换。
pairs.translation: // Global Market settings: sources (only never-refreshed built-in official sources in recordings) and empty entry snapshots; scenarios replace external refresh/aggregation/details.

pairs.source: // 新建项目向导：TTS 配音的预填值（全局默认）。
pairs.translation: // New-project wizards: TTS prefilled values (global defaults).

pairs.source: // 资产库：默认的「角色」标签首页（项目画廊「从资产库导入」同一请求）、画廊的资产图状态，以及入库预览按名称查重。
pairs.translation: // Asset libraries: default Characters first pages (same request as gallery Import from library), gallery asset-image states and name-duplicate checks for add previews.

pairs.source: // 项目设置：Agent 配置状态与项目记忆（演示项目没有定制配置与记忆文件，多条目由场景替换）。
pairs.translation: // Project settings: Agent configuration states/project memory (demos lack custom configurations/memory files; scenarios replace entries).

pairs.source: // 项目「分集」视图：演示项目没有整本源文，只有一集无原文的集；整本源文、多集与未登记文件由场景替换。
pairs.translation: // Project Episodes views: demos lack whole sources and contain only one sourceless episode; scenarios replace whole sources/multiple episodes/unregistered files.

pairs.source: // 项目「文件」视图：项目根与 scripts 目录（演示项目只有一集的空正式脚本；多文件、长文件名与预览正文由场景替换）。
pairs.translation: // Project Files views: project roots/scripts directories (demos contain only one empty formal episode script; scenarios replace multiple files/long filenames/preview bodies).

pairs.source: // 文件视图的「项目回收站」分区：演示项目没有删除记录，多条记录由场景替换。
pairs.translation: // File-view Project trash sections: demos lack deletion records; scenarios supply multiple records.

pairs.source: // 集页「多宫格分镜图」：宫格档位上限与宫格记录（演示项目没有宫格，多组联合图由场景替换）。
pairs.translation: // Episode Multi-grid storyboard images: grid-tier limits/records (demos lack grids; scenarios supply grouped composites).

pairs.source: // 集页剪辑视图：演示集还没有视频，也就没有剪辑时间线，显示空状态；有剪辑时间线的读取结果与出片现状由场景替换。
pairs.translation: // Episode editing views: demos lack videos and therefore editing timelines, showing empty states; scenarios replace timeline reads/export states.

pairs.source: // 资产库里的演示资产：两个角色、一个场景、一个道具，都没有图片。
pairs.translation: // Demo library assets: two characters, one scene and one prop, all without images.

pairs.source: // 每次录制都会变的不透明值：令牌按签发时刻生成，项目修订号是含创建时间的 project.json 摘要。
pairs.translation: // Opaque values changing each recording: tokens derive from issuance times; project revisions digest project.json including creation times.

pairs.source: // 同一次录制里相同的 uuid 映射到同一个固定值，按首次出现的顺序编号。
pairs.translation: // Identical UUIDs within recordings map to identical fixed values, numbered in first-appearance order.

pairs.source: // 后端尚未开始监听。
pairs.translation: // Backends have not started listening yet.

pairs.source: // 取真实路径：macOS 的临时目录经 /var → /private/var 符号链接，后端返回的是解析后的路径
pairs.translation: // Resolve real paths: macOS temporary directories use /var → /private/var symlinks; backends return resolved paths.

pairs.source: // 后端启动时会读 .env（含向上查找到的主仓 .env），里面的 DATABASE_URL 会把录制接到开发者的库。
pairs.translation: // Backend startup reads .env, including parent main-checkout .env, whose DATABASE_URL would connect recording to developer databases.

pairs.source: // 数据库落在临时数据目录里，不碰开发者自己的库。
pairs.translation: // Databases reside in temporary roots, never touching developer databases.

 * `Last-Event-ID`) and reconnect counts.
 */

/**

 * Install through `vi.stubGlobal("fetch", …)`; `status` determines connection response statuses, potentially by call index.

 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 让流式读取与解析跑完，事件回调在此之后可断言。
 *
 * 终止条件是消费方停止索要数据（一整轮让出都没有新的 `pull` 或新连接），不是固定圈数——
 * 圈数是对 fetch → reader → parser 调用链长度的猜测，链路多一跳或调度稍慢就会提前返回，
 * 让断言撞上尚未派发的事件。只要消费方还在推进就继续等，流结束或建连被拒时无新进展即返回。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Finish streaming reads/parsing before asserting event callbacks.
 *
 * Stop when consumers cease requesting data (an entire yield round without new `pull` or connections), never after fixed round counts:
 * counts guess fetch → reader → parser chain lengths; extra hops/slower scheduling can return prematurely,
 * racing assertions against undispatched events. Wait while consumers advance; return without progress after stream completion/rejected connections.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 以 `fetch` 消费 `text/event-stream` 的流式客户端。
 *
 * 浏览器原生 `EventSource` 带不了 `Authorization` header，这里用 `fetch` 自带 header 建连，
 * 并自行承担 `EventSource` 原本提供的两件事：断线后按指数退避自动重建，重建时携带
 * `Last-Event-ID` 让服务端从游标续传。每次重建都重新取一遍 headers，凭证刷新后自然生效。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Streaming `fetch` client for `text/event-stream`.
 *
 * Browser `EventSource` cannot carry `Authorization`; use `fetch` headers and implement
 * two native `EventSource` responsibilities: reconnect with exponential backoff and send
 * `Last-Event-ID` cursors. Refetch headers on each connection so credential updates apply naturally.
 */

pairs.source: /** 服务端 `event:` 字段；未声明时与浏览器行为一致，视为 `message`。 */
pairs.translation: /** Server `event:` values; absent values mean `message`, matching browsers. */

pairs.source: /** false 表示服务端明确拒绝（认证失败、资源不存在等），客户端不再重连。 */
pairs.translation: /** false means explicit server rejection, such as authentication/missing resources, without reconnection. */

pairs.source: /** 每次建连前调用，返回附加的请求头（凭证、语言等）。 */
pairs.translation: /** Called before each connection for additional headers, credentials/languages/etc. */

pairs.source: /** 每次成功建立连接（含重连）后调用一次。 */
pairs.translation: /** Called once after every successful connection, including reconnections. */

pairs.source: /** 连接失败或中断时调用；`error.retryable` 为 true 时随后按退避重连。 */
pairs.translation: /** Called on failed/interrupted connections; `error.retryable` triggers backoff reconnects. */

pairs.source: /** 首次退避延迟（毫秒），服务端 `retry:` 字段可覆盖。 */
pairs.translation: /** Initial backoff milliseconds, overridable by server `retry:`. */

pairs.source: /** 关闭连接并停止重连；幂等。 */
pairs.translation: /** Close connections/stop reconnection, idempotently. */

pairs.source: /** 最近一次收到的事件 id，重连时作为 `Last-Event-ID` 发送。 */
pairs.translation: /** Latest received event id, sent as `Last-Event-ID` on reconnect. */

pairs.source: /** 这些状态是服务端对请求本身的否定，重试不会改变结果。 */
pairs.translation: /** Server rejection statuses that retries cannot change. */

pairs.source:
/**
   * 后台标签页的长连接常被系统或代理断开，重连在后台反复失败会把退避推到上限。用户切回时
   * 抢占剩余等待并把退避归零：切回前台是「网络条件已变」的强信号，等待剩下的几十秒只会让
   * 页面继续停在旧数据上。连接中或已连接（`retryTimer` 为空）时不做任何事。
   */
pairs.translation:
/**
   * Systems/proxies often drop background-tab connections; repeated background failures raise backoff to limits. Returning users
   * preempt remaining waits and reset backoff: foregrounding strongly signals changed network conditions, whereas tens of seconds
   * more delay retain stale pages. Connecting/connected states (empty `retryTimer`) do nothing.
   */

pairs.source: /** 两条终态路径共用：`close()` 与不可重试的失败都必须摘掉监听，否则句柄已死仍挂在 `document` 上。 */
pairs.translation: /** Shared terminal cleanup: both `close()` and nonretryable failures remove listeners, avoiding dead handles on `document`. */

pairs.source: // 按 EventSource 规范：不带 data 的块里的 id 同样更新续传位置；空 id 清空续传位置，重连不再带头。
pairs.translation: // EventSource rules: id in data-less blocks still updates cursors; empty id clears cursors, omitting reconnect headers.

pairs.translation: // Receiving events proves usable connections and resets backoff. Resetting on 2xx headers alone lets

 * Timeline lists/split views/details/reference sections share this, avoiding drift among duplicate ternaries.
 */

pairs.source: /** 取条目 ID（segment_id / scene_id / shot_id）。 */
pairs.translation: /** Extract entry IDs (segment_id / scene_id / shot_id). */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 取剧集剧本在该模式下的条目数组（segments / shots / scenes）。
 *
 * 未注册的模式返回空数组：以其他模式的形状渲染会让保存分派到错误端点。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Episode entry arrays for modes: segments / shots / scenes.
 *
 * Unregistered modes return empty arrays; rendering alternate shapes would dispatch saves to wrong endpoints.
 */

pairs.source: /** 取该模式下条目的角色引用字段名。 */
pairs.translation: /** Character-reference field names for mode entries. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 集总时长 = 逐条目 `duration_seconds` 求和。
 *
 * 它是派生值，剧本不落盘一份（服务端由项目摘要按同一口径读时计算）。各画布共用这一份
 * 实现，避免同一个数在时间线与宫格两处各写一遍、健壮度还不一致。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Episode total duration = sum of entry `duration_seconds`.
 *
 * Derived values never persist in scripts (servers compute on read from summaries with identical rules). All canvases share
 * this implementation, avoiding duplicate timeline/grid calculations with divergent robustness.
 */

pairs.source: /** 覆盖 jsdom 的只读 `document.visibilityState`；afterEach 删除自有属性即还原。 */
pairs.translation: /** Override readonly jsdom `document.visibilityState`; afterEach removes own properties to restore. */

pairs.source: // 建连成功但一个事件都没送到就断流：这条连接没证明自己可用，退避继续增长到 8s，
pairs.translation: // Connections accepted then closed before any events never prove usable; backoff keeps increasing to 8s,

pairs.source: // 不回落到首个延迟——否则「接受连接后立刻断流」的坏代理会被按秒重连。
pairs.translation: // never resetting initial delays, or accept-then-drop proxies reconnect every second.

pairs.source: // 收到事件才算连接可用，退避归零：再断线只等首个延迟。
pairs.translation: // Events prove usability/reset backoff; later disconnects wait initial delays only.

pairs.source: // 句柄自行进入终态时调用方通常不再 close()，而 close() 对已关闭的句柄直接返回：
pairs.translation: // Self-terminal handles normally receive no further close(), which also returns directly when already closed;

pairs.source: // 监听只有在这条路径上就地摘掉，才不会连同整个闭包（onMessage 回调等）常驻 document。
pairs.translation: // remove listeners on terminal paths to avoid document retaining entire closures such as onMessage.

pairs.source: // 关闭后即便流随后结束也不再重连。
pairs.translation: // Closing prevents reconnects even if streams later end.

pairs.source: // 连续失败把退避推到 30s 上限：1s → 2s → 4s → 8s → 16s → 30s。
pairs.translation: // Consecutive failures increase backoff to 30s: 1s → 2s → 4s → 8s → 16s → 30s.

pairs.source: // 被抢占的 30s 定时器不再补发一次连接。
pairs.translation: // Preempted 30s timers never issue extra connections.

pairs.source: // 退避归零：这次失败只等首个延迟 1s。
pairs.translation: // Reset backoff: failures now wait initial 1s only.

pairs.source: // 已连接：没有待执行的重连，事件不做任何事。
pairs.translation: // Already connected without pending reconnects, so events do nothing.

pairs.source: // 退避等待中但页面仍不可见：不抢占定时器。
pairs.translation: // Hidden pages waiting backoff never preempt timers.

pairs.source: // 原定时器照常到点重连。
pairs.translation: // Original timers reconnect normally when due.

pairs.source: // 回显 key 与参数，便于断言文案选择逻辑。
pairs.translation: // Echo keys/parameters to assert copy-selection logic.

pairs.source: // 失败通知按条目在本集里的当前位置称呼：E1S01 与 E1U1 都排在第 2 位，与 ID 序号不同。
pairs.translation: // Failure notifications use current episode positions: E1S01/E1U1 both occupy position 2, unlike ID suffixes.

pairs.source: // task.script_file 带前缀也能匹配 episodes 中带前缀的记录
pairs.translation: // Prefixed task.script_file matches prefixed episode records.

pairs.source: // 拒因只进通知文案，不参与 target 解析。
pairs.translation: // Rejections enter notification copy only, never target resolution.

pairs.source: // error_message 是上游原文，可能带 i18next 占位符字面量；它不参与插值，
pairs.translation: // Raw upstream error_message may contain literal i18next placeholders; never interpolate it,

pairs.source: // 拒因必须仍落在后缀里。
pairs.translation: // preserving rejection suffix positions.

pairs.source: // 级联失败等非 provider_rejected 失败没有拒因字段，文案不变。
pairs.translation: // Non-provider_rejected failures such as cascades lack rejection fields, leaving copy unchanged.

pairs.source:
/**
 * 时长计算只需要任务行上的状态与三个时间戳，故按结构取而不取整个 `TaskItem`——
 * 工作流面板的任务观测（`WorkflowTaskObservation`）不携带时间戳，须先从任务队列
 * 取回同一 task_id 的时间戳再喂进来，宽入参让两侧共用同一实现。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Duration calculation needs task states/three timestamps, so accept structural inputs, not entire `TaskItem`:
 * workflow `WorkflowTaskObservation` lacks timestamps and must fetch matching task_id rows first.
 * Broad input shapes share one implementation across both consumers.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 时长的语义。三者陈述的不是同一段区间：`queued` 是尚未开跑的等待，`running` 是
 * 仍在推进的运行，`total` 是已定格的整次执行耗时。文案必须分开，否则终态任务的
 * 数字会被读成「还在跑」。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Duration semantics describe distinct intervals: `queued` waits before starting, `running` remains
 * in progress, `total` is frozen whole-execution time. Separate copy prevents terminal
 * numbers appearing still running.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 终态任务的整次执行耗时；起止时间戳缺失或不可解析时返回 null。
 *
 * 单独成一个不收 `now` 的入口，是因为这段区间已经定格：调用方据此判断该读数无需订阅
 * 时钟，而不必先算一次时长再回头看它属于哪一种。非终态任务不该走这里。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Whole-execution duration for terminal tasks; null for missing/unparseable start/end timestamps.
 *
 * Separate entries without `now` signal frozen intervals, letting callers avoid clock subscriptions
 * without calculating first and inspecting types afterward. Nonterminal tasks must not use this.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 任务当前该呈现的时长；无法计算时返回 null，由调用方整块不渲染。
 *
 * 返回 null 而非 0 是为了区分「真的刚开始」与「算不出来」——后者若渲染成 `0s`，
 * 会把缺时间戳的异常任务伪装成正常起跑。终态时长与 `now` 无关，故不随计时器递增。
 * 时钟回拨（前后端时钟不同步、started_at 落在未来）截断为 0，不显示负数。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Currently displayable task durations, null when uncomputable, letting callers omit entire readouts.
 *
 * Null differs from 0 to distinguish just started from unknown; `0s` would disguise abnormal
 * missing timestamps as normal starts. Terminal durations ignore `now`, never increasing with timers.
 * Backward clocks (unsynchronized frontend/backend or future started_at) clamp to 0, never negatives.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 按量级选精度的展示分解：不足一分钟给秒、不足一小时给分秒、其余给时分。
 * 毫秒一律不呈现——它对「任务跑了多久」这个判断没有信息量，只会让数字跳动刺眼。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Magnitude-based precision: seconds below minutes, minutes/seconds below hours, otherwise hours/minutes.
 * Never milliseconds, which add no useful elapsed-task information and distract through rapid changes.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 时长文案的取词器。只需要「按 key 取一条带插值的 `common` 文案」，故按最小形状收窄，
 * 任意命名空间的 `t` 都能直接传进来——键名在这里一律带 `common:` 前缀。
 */

/**
 * 时长的呈现文案。单位词与语序由 `common:elapsed_*` 模板给，全站时长共用这一处：
 * 同一段时长在任务读数与用量表里必须是同一种写法。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Duration copy, with units/order from `common:elapsed_*`, shared sitewide:
 * equal intervals must read identically in tasks and usage tables.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * Agent 凭证 base_url 的归一与校验，与后端 lib/config/url_utils.py 逐字对应。
 *
 * 「存储值即调用值」：Claude CLI 内置 SDK 固定在 base_url 后拼 /v1/messages，
 * 前端预览的地址必须与后端探测、运行时请求是同一个字符串。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Normalize/validate Agent credential base_url, matching backend lib/config/url_utils.py exactly.
 *
 * Stored values are called values: Claude CLI SDK always appends /v1/messages,
 * so frontend previews must equal backend probes/runtime request strings.
 */

pairs.source: /** Claude CLI 固定追加的路径段。 */
pairs.translation: /** Path segments always appended by Claude CLI. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 去首尾空白、去尾部斜杠；末尾恰好是 /v1/messages 时去掉这一段。
 *
 * 不剥 /vN、不剥单独的 /messages，也不识别或追加 /anthropic 类子路径。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Trim edge whitespace/trailing slashes; remove exact trailing /v1/messages.
 *
 * Never strip /vN or standalone /messages, nor recognize/append /anthropic subpaths.
 */

pairs.source: // 剥掉端点后再去一次尾斜杠：https://x//v1/messages 的存储值须是 https://x。
pairs.translation: // Remove trailing slashes again after endpoint stripping: https://x//v1/messages must store https://x.

pairs.source: /** 归一后的调用地址预览；与后端 messages_url 同值。 */
pairs.translation: /** Normalized request previews, equal to backend messages_url. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 是否含后端一律 422 的成分：query、fragment、userinfo。
 *
 * 其余非法形态（缺 scheme / host 等）交给后端判定，避免前端复刻一套解析规则。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Whether inputs contain backend-always-422 query/fragment/userinfo.
 *
 * Other invalid shapes (missing scheme/host, etc.) defer to servers, avoiding duplicated frontend parsing rules.
 */

pairs.source: // 供应商配置可变（用户在设置页改模型 supported_durations / 启用状态等），前端不持久缓存它：
pairs.translation: // Provider configuration changes (supported_durations/enablement/etc.), so frontend never persistently caches it:

pairs.source: // 每次消费都直拉后端，避免长生命周期副本与后端单一真相源漂移（ADR 0035，ADR 0018/0013 的前端推论）。
pairs.translation: // fetch backends per consumption, avoiding long-lived copies drifting from backend truth (ADR 0035, frontend implications of ADR 0018/0013).

pairs.source: /** 目录里的供应商名与模型名（"provider/model" 为键），均已按 Accept-Language 成文。 */
pairs.translation: /** Catalog provider/model names keyed by "provider/model", already rendered through Accept-Language. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 从目录（`/providers` 与 `/custom-providers`）抽出显示名表，作为候选响应之外的兜底层。
 *
 * 两个端点都不按可用性收窄，候选与整页配置则只列 ready 的内置供应商与已启用的自定义模型；
 * 而生效值可以指向一个已失去凭证的内置供应商，或一个被停用的自定义模型（停用不清引用）。
 * 那时下拉触发按钮仍要显示名字，而不是 `custom-3 · my-model` 这样的裸 id。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Extract display-name maps from catalogs (`/providers` / `/custom-providers`) as fallback beneath candidates.
 *
 * Neither endpoint narrows availability, unlike candidate/config lists limited to ready built-ins/enabled custom models;
 * effective values may still reference built-ins with lost credentials or disabled custom models (disabling preserves references).
 * Dropdown triggers must still show names, never bare IDs such as `custom-3 · my-model`.
 */

pairs.source: // 自定义模型的时长由对应的模型条目给出，前端只看得到用户写下的时长覆盖；
pairs.translation: // Custom-model durations come from corresponding catalog entries; frontends see only user-entered overrides;

pairs.source: // 其余情形交给服务端的能力查询（useModelCapabilities）
pairs.translation: // leave other cases to server capability queries (useModelCapabilities).

pairs.source:
/**
 * 目录里该模型的时长全集，升序；目录查不到为 null。
 *
 * 这是型号声明、不经任何联动约束收窄的集合，供「展示模型规格」与「切换模型时判断已选时长
 * 是否仍属于新模型」这类同步场景使用。按当前分辨率 / 参考图路径收窄后的可选集只由服务端
 * video-capabilities 端点回答（`useModelCapabilities`），前端不复算收窄规则。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Complete ascending model-duration sets from catalogs; null when unresolved.
 *
 * Declared sets without contextual narrowing, for synchronous model-spec displays and checking selected durations
 * against newly switched models. Current resolution/reference-path narrowed options come only from server
 * video-capabilities endpoints (`useModelCapabilities`); frontends never duplicate narrowing rules.
 */

pairs.source: /** 目录（非自定义供应商）里的视频音轨能力：音轨是否存在 + 服务端派生的声音一致性档位。 */
pairs.translation: /** Catalog video audio capabilities (noncustom providers): track presence plus server-derived voice-consistency tiers. */

pairs.source: /** 无项目上下文下的档位，服务端派生。有项目上下文时改用能力查询结果，不读此值。 */
pairs.translation: /** Server-derived tiers without project contexts; with projects, query capabilities instead of reading this value. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 给定 "provider/model"，查目录里的音频相关声明——下拉能力线（音轨）与全局设置页的档位
 * 徽章共用同一份查表。自定义供应商目录无逐模型声明，与服务端 `_resolve_video_caps_for_model`
 * 同口径固定假定有声（soft）——无信号时判定为有声但保证降级，比误判为无声更不易误导。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Look up audio declarations by "provider/model", shared by dropdown audio capabilities/global tier
 * badges. Custom catalogs lack per-model declarations; match server `_resolve_video_caps_for_model`
 * by assuming audio (soft). Without signals, audio with degraded guarantees is less misleading than falsely assuming silence.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 查该 `provider/model` 在某条执行路径上的音频开关可控性；查不到模型返回 null（调用方按可控
 * 处理，不收紧）。
 *
 * 三态由服务端从 backend 的 VideoCapabilities 派生，前端只按路径取对应字段，不解读
 * capabilities token、也不自行合成三态。恒有声与恒无声的成片音轨不随开关变化，设置界面据此
 * 禁用开关——否则用户的关闭意图到不了供应商，却会让编排层按无声裁掉全部音色约束。
 *
 * `route` 必传：同一 model 的两条子路径可以给出不同答案（可灵 v3-omni 图生可控、参考生无
 * 开关），按无路径上下文的值渲染会让参考生视频的用户开了音频却拿到无声成片。
 *
 * 自定义供应商目录无逐模型音轨声明，与服务端 `_resolve_video_caps_for_model` 同口径按「无
 * 信号不收紧」处理，保持开关可控。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Audio-toggle controllability for `provider/model` on execution paths; unresolved models yield null (callers assume controllable,
 * without tightening).
 *
 * Servers derive tristates from backend VideoCapabilities; frontends select path fields without interpreting
 * capability tokens or synthesizing states. Always-audio/always-silent outputs ignore toggles, so settings disable
 * them; otherwise Off intentions cannot reach providers yet orchestrators would strip all timbre constraints as silent.
 *
 * `route` is required: the same model may differ by subpath (Kling v3-omni controls image-to-video but lacks reference-to-video
 * toggles); context-free values could let users enable audio while receiving silent reference outputs.
 *
 * Custom-provider catalogs lack per-model audio declarations; match server `_resolve_video_caps_for_model`
 * by never tightening without signals, leaving toggles controllable.
 */

pairs.source:
/** `provider/model` 挂接的那个端点对尺寸与时长的约束；内置供应商与查不到的模型为 undefined。
 *
 *  内置供应商没有「维度被端点固定」这一形态：尺寸与时长都是请求参数，端点目录里也没有它们的
 *  约束项。故只对自定义供应商的模型行查表。
 */
pairs.translation:
/** Size/duration constraints from endpoints associated with `provider/model`; undefined for built-ins/unresolved models.
 *
 *  Built-ins have no endpoint-fixed dimensions: sizes/durations are request parameters, with no corresponding
 *  endpoint-catalog constraints. Look up custom-provider model rows only.
 */

pairs.source:
/** 分辨率选择器的空值占位：说清「不选会得到什么」。
 *
 *  三种说法。端点报得出原生尺寸（ComfyUI 端点的宽高绑定读得到字面值）就报它；尺寸由该端点
 *  固定、却连字面值都读不出来（宽高两侧都没绑定是最常见的一种）时说「由 workflow 决定」——
 *  此时选择器本就禁用，通用的「默认（不传）」会让人以为这里还有一个「不传」的选项可挑；其余
 *  端点不选即不下发该参数，那句「默认（不传）」说的正是实情。
 */
pairs.translation:
/** Resolution empty placeholders explain outcomes of no selection.
 *
 *  Three forms: report native dimensions when available (literal ComfyUI width/height bindings); when endpoints fix dimensions
 *  without readable literals (most commonly both unbound width/height), say Determined by workflow.
 *  Selectors are already disabled, and generic Default (omit) would imply selectable omission choices; other
 *  endpoints omit parameters on no selection, accurately described by Default (omit).
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 复刻 Anthropic 官方参考实现：模型在处理前把图片缩到同时满足边长与视觉 token 两条
 * 限制的最大等比尺寸。见 https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/vision-coordinates
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Reproduce Anthropic official references: models resize to largest proportional dimensions satisfying both
 * edge-length/vision-token limits. See https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/vision-coordinates
 */

pairs.source: /** 视觉 token 数：每 28×28 像素一块，一块 1 个 token。 */
pairs.translation: /** Vision tokens: one token per 28×28 pixel block. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 四舍六入五取偶（banker's rounding），与 Python 的 `round()` 一致。
 * 服务端把恰好 .5 的短边解析为偶数邻值，`Math.round` 一律进位，两者对部分图片
 * 会算出相差 1 像素的尺寸。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Half-even banker's rounding, matching Python `round()`.
 * Server exactly-.5 short edges choose even neighbors; `Math.round` always rounds upward,
 * differing by one pixel for some images.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 模型缩放（补边之前）后的像素尺寸，返回 `[width, height]`。
 *
 * 默认参数是标准分辨率档。已经落在两条限制内的图片原样返回。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Model-resized pixel dimensions before padding, returning `[width, height]`.
 *
 * Defaults use standard resolution tiers. Images satisfying both limits return unchanged.
 */

pairs.source: // 沿长边二分：找出仍然合规的最大等比尺寸。
pairs.translation: // Binary search along long edges for largest valid proportional sizes.

pairs.source: // lo 恒合规
pairs.translation: // lo always valid.

pairs.source: // hi 恒不合规
pairs.translation: // hi always invalid.

pairs.source: /** 项目的全部剧本（`projects-store` 的 `currentScripts`）。 */
pairs.translation: /** All project scripts (`projects-store` `currentScripts`). */

pairs.source: // 条目 ID 的集 ID 前缀：E3S01 / E3U02 / E3G01 里的 E3。
pairs.translation: // Episode ID prefixes: E3 from E3S01 / E3U02 / E3G01.

pairs.source: /** 一集在播出顺序（episodes[] 排列）中的位置，从 1 起；不在账本里时为 null。 */
pairs.translation: /** One-based broadcast position in episodes[]; null outside ledgers. */

pairs.source: /** 创作者看到的集名：标题，没有标题时是播出位置。 */
pairs.translation: /** Creator-visible episode names: titles, otherwise broadcast positions. */

pairs.source: /** 发给 Agent 的集指称：集名与集 ID 一起给，Agent 调工具只用集 ID，对创作者复述用集名。 */
pairs.translation: /** Agent episode references include names/IDs: tools use IDs only, creator-facing retelling uses names. */

pairs.source: /** 条目 ID 的集内部分：E3S01 → S01；没有集 ID 前缀时原样返回。只用于不是分镜或视频单元的条目（宫格）。 */
pairs.translation: /** Intraepisode IDs: E3S01 → S01, unchanged without prefixes. Only for nonstoryboard/nonvideo-unit entries (grids). */

pairs.source: /** 条目的类型名加位置：「分镜 5」「视频单元 5」；条目已不在剧本里时为「已删除」。 */
pairs.translation: /** Entry type plus position, such as Storyboard 5 / Video unit 5; Deleted if absent from scripts. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 集页面之外指称条目：「标题 · 5」，条目已不在剧本里时「标题 · 已删除」；已移出账本的集使用未命名集。
 * 宫格这类不按位置指称的条目保持「标题 · G01」。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Entry references outside episode pages: Title · 5, or Title · Deleted when absent from scripts; episodes removed from ledgers use Untitled episode.

pairs.source:
/**
 * 会话事件日志投影 — entries → Turn[]。
 *

 * stream_event 不入日志），本模块只做渲染归组：连续 assistant 条目合并、
 * tool_result 按 tool_use_id 回填、task 按 task_id 就地更新；压缩续接摘要
 * 投影为 compact_summary 块，缺锚点子智能体的推断终态挂到合成卡片上。
 * 不做内容嗅探、不做内容比对去重、不合成消息。
 *
 * 投影分两层：
 * - 内部累积态（fold）：逐条消费条目，只做追加与按 id 回填，永不回溯重放；
 *   条目块在此层做唯一一次深拷贝。
 * - 展示视图（display）：由累积态按 turn 派生——task 折叠、滞留子智能体推导
 *   完成、子智能体子时间线挂载都在这层重算；按 turn 版本缓存，只有被新
 *   条目触达的 turn 重建视图，未触达的 turn 保持引用稳定。
 *
 * `projectEntriesToTurns` 是纯函数入口（空投影器全量重放）；
 * `createTimelineProjector` 是同一实现的增量入口，二者结果恒等。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Session-event-log projection: entries → Turn[].
 *
 * Server write points already shape entries (standalone tool_result, typed interrupts/task notifications/
 * AskUserQuestion answers, subagent parent_tool_use_id,
 * stream_event excluded from logs). This module groups for rendering only: merge consecutive assistant entries,
 * backfill tool_result by tool_use_id, update tasks in place by task_id; compaction continuation summaries
 * become compact_summary blocks, with inferred unanchored-subagent terminal states on synthetic cards.
 * Never sniff contents, deduplicate by contents or synthesize messages.
 *
 * Two projection layers:
 * - Internal accumulation (fold): consume entries individually, appending/backfilling by ID without historical replay;
 *   blocks receive their sole deep copies here.
 * - Display: derive from accumulated turns, recalculating task collapse, stranded-subagent inferred
 *   completion and sub-timeline attachments here; cache by turn versions so only newly touched
 *   turns rebuild views, preserving untouched references.
 *
 * `projectEntriesToTurns` is the pure entry point (empty projectors replay everything);
 * `createTimelineProjector` incrementally uses identical implementation, always yielding identical results.
 */

pairs.translation:

 */

pairs.translation: // Pasted `@[名<BOM>称]`: backends remove BOM at parser entry; failure to mirror would mark names unregistered and split previews/generation.

pairs.translation: // Match backend split_speech_line: whitespace-only speakers form no tokens, preventing invalid utterances.

pairs.source: // JS 的 `\s` 不含 U+001F 而 Python 的 str.isspace() 含：少这一个字符，
pairs.translation: // JS `\s` excludes U+001F, unlike Python str.isspace(); omitting this character

pairs.translation: // binds speakers server-side but derives image references frontend-side.

pairs.translation: // Match backend split_speech_line: outer `{` forms no token; resume scanning inside.

pairs.source:
/**
 * Mention regex shared across frontend tokenizers. Mirrors backend
 * `lib/script/reference_video/text_parser.py` mention scanner — keep in sync.
 *
 * 前后端字面不同但语义等价：
 * - JS `\w` 永远是 ASCII-only，`(?<!\w)` 直接表达"左侧不是 ASCII 词字符"。
 * - Python `\w` 默认 Unicode-aware（中文属 `\w`），所以后端改用显式
 *   `[A-Za-z0-9_]` 字符类，避免误拒 `你好@张三` 这类中文前缀。
 *
 * CJK 字符（`\u4e00-\u9fff`）在两边都不在词字符集内，所以中文前缀合法。
 *
 * Supports legacy `@名称` plus wrapped `@[名称]` for asset names
 * containing punctuation, spaces, or parentheses.
 *
 * Curly-brace wrapping (`@{名称}`) is intentionally unsupported: the editor
 * only emits `@[名称]`, and braces are the speech syntax (see {@link splitSpeechLine}).
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Mention regex shared across frontend tokenizers. Mirrors backend
 * `lib/script/reference_video/text_parser.py` mention scanner; keep in sync.
 *
 * Different frontend/backend literals have equivalent semantics:
 * - JS `\w` is always ASCII-only; `(?<!\w)` directly means no ASCII word character on the left.
 * - Python `\w` defaults to Unicode-aware (Chinese belongs to `\w`), so backends explicitly use
 *   `[A-Za-z0-9_]` to avoid rejecting Chinese prefixes like `你好@张三`.
 *
 * CJK (`\u4e00-\u9fff`) is outside word-character sets on both sides, permitting Chinese prefixes.
 *
 * Supports legacy `@名称` plus wrapped `@[名称]` for asset names
 * containing punctuation, spaces, or parentheses.
 *
 * Curly-brace wrapping (`@{名称}`) is intentionally unsupported: the editor
 * only emits `@[名称]`, and braces are the speech syntax (see {@link splitSpeechLine}).
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * BOM / ZWNBSP。镜像后端 `text_parser._BOM`：正文里它没有语义，却让按字节走的判定分叉
 * ——JS 的 `\s` 认它、Python 的 `str.strip()` 不认，带 BOM 的记号在前端认、在
 * 后端不认，说话人是否进参考图两侧结论相反。
 */

/**
 * 引用语法文本的入口归一：去掉全部 U+FEFF，并把编码形式收敛到 Unicode NFC。镜像后端
 * `lib/script/reference_video/text_parser.py::_normalize_source`——两条派生路径同口径。
 *
 * 两者同一性质：屏幕上看不见的字节差异，却让按字节走的判定分叉，故合并在一个入口处理。
 * BOM 不止出现在文档开头，粘贴拼接会把它带到任意行首，而分叉是按行发生的；NFC 则是资产名
 * 比对的坐标系（见 {@link normalizeAssetName}），正文以 NFD 书写、资产表以 NFC 登记时肉眼
 * 同字却判不相等。
 *
 * 归一落在解析入口而非提取结果上：BOM 落在名字内部（`@[名<U+FEFF>称]`）时，逐名补归一修不了——
 * 匹配已经按含 BOM 的字节做完了。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Normalize reference-syntax inputs: remove every U+FEFF and normalize encoding to Unicode NFC, matching backend
 * `lib/script/reference_video/text_parser.py::_normalize_source` so both derivation paths agree.
 *
 * Both are invisible byte differences splitting byte-based decisions, therefore handled at one entry point.
 * BOM occurs beyond document starts: pasted concatenations put it at arbitrary line starts, with line-local divergence. NFC defines asset-name
 * comparison coordinates (see {@link normalizeAssetName}); NFD bodies against NFC registries can look identical
 * while comparing unequal.
 *
 * Normalize parser inputs, never just extracted results: BOM inside names (`@[名<U+FEFF>称]`) cannot be fixed per-name afterward,
 * since matching already used BOM-containing bytes.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 从 mention 匹配取名字。归一在此完成而非交给调用方：高亮分词器（`tokenizePrompt`）要
 * 逐字拼回原文、不能归一源文本，只有名字这一路出得来规范形。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Extract matched mention names, normalizing here rather than in callers: highlighting tokenizers (`tokenizePrompt`) must
 * reconstruct source character by character without source normalization, so only name extraction can return canonical forms.
 */

pairs.source: /** 空台词（`{}` / `{   }`）不算发声记号——同后端：utterance 的 text 必须非空。 */
pairs.translation: /** Empty dialogue (`{}`/`{   }`) forms no speech tokens, matching backend nonempty utterance text. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 引用名里分隔本体与衍生的字符。镜像后端 `lib/references/reference_catalog.py::DERIVATIVE_SEPARATOR`——
 * 它在资产名与衍生名里都非法，故 `本体名/衍生名` 的切分无歧义。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Character separating bases/derivatives in reference names, mirroring backend `lib/references/reference_catalog.py::DERIVATIVE_SEPARATOR`.
 * Invalid within both asset/derivative names, making `本体名/衍生名` splitting unambiguous.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 把一个引用名拆成 `[本体名, 衍生名]`；不是衍生形态时衍生名为空串。镜像后端
 * `lib/references/reference_catalog.py::split_derivative_reference`。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Split references into `[本体名, 衍生名]`; nonderivative names return empty derivative names. Mirrors backend
 * `lib/references/reference_catalog.py::split_derivative_reference`.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 行内一段发声记号；`speaker` 为空串即画外音。`raw` 是它在原行里占据的整段原文。
 *
 * 说话人位写 `@[角色/衍生]` 时 `speaker` 仍是本体名、`derivative` 记下那个衍生名：声音属于
 * 身份，衍生共享本体的参考音频与音色（镜像后端 `text_parser.SpeechMark`）。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Inline speech tokens; empty `speaker` means voiceover. `raw` preserves entire original spans.
 *
 * `@[角色/衍生]` speakers retain base names in `speaker` and derivative names in `derivative`: voices belong to
 * identities, with derivatives sharing base reference audio/timbre (backend `text_parser.SpeechMark`).
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * mention 与 `{` 之间允许的行内空白。JS 的 `\s` 不含 U+001F 而 Python 的 `str.isspace()` 含，
 * 少这一个字符会让 `@[张三]<U+001F>{我来了}` 在后端绑说话人、在前端派生成参考图。
 */
// eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex -- 须显式匹配 U+001F，对齐 Python str.isspace()
pairs.translation: // eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex -- Explicit U+001F matching aligns Python str.isspace()

pairs.source: /** 说话人 mention 与 `{` 之间允许出现的分隔冒号（中英各一），只允许一个。 */
pairs.translation: /** Single separator colons, Chinese or English, permitted between speaker mentions/`{`. */

pairs.source: /** `splitSpeechLine` 的一段：字符串是画面描述，对象是发声记号。 */
pairs.translation: /** `splitSpeechLine` parts: strings describe visuals, objects represent speech tokens. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 把一行拆成「画面描述片段」与「发声记号」的有序序列。镜像后端
 * `lib/script/reference_video/text_parser.py::split_speech_line`——两条派生路径同口径，
 * 改一侧必须同步改另一侧。
 *
 * 记号可出现在行内任意位置：`{台词}` 是画外音；紧接在 `@[角色]` 之后（中间允许空白或一个
 * 中英冒号）的 `{台词}` 是该角色说这句话。空台词、说话人位为空白、说话人位写坏
 * （`@[]{…}`、`@[张三]：：{…}`）三种一律不成记号，花括号留在描述片段里由调用侧出 warning。
 *
 * 与后端的一处刻意差异：本函数**不归一源文本**，只归一取出的说话人名。高亮分词器要逐字
 * 拼回原文覆盖在 textarea 上，归一会让 token 拼不回去；判定路径（`extractMentions` /
 * `toScriptLines`）的输入来自已归一的 `splitScriptLines`，故两侧结论仍一致。
 *
 * mention 与 `{` 之间的空白按 `INLINE_SPACE_RE` 判——JS 的 `\s` 比 Python 的 `str.isspace()`
 * 少一个 U+001F（更粗的 U+001C–U+001E / U+0085 由 `LINE_BREAK_RE` 当换行切走、根本不在行内，
 * U+FEFF 则被后端入口归一去掉、在此由 `\s` 命中），补进字符类后两侧空白集合逐字符相同。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Split lines into ordered visual-description fragments/speech tokens, mirroring backend
 * `lib/script/reference_video/text_parser.py::split_speech_line` across derivation paths;
 * changing either requires updating the other.
 *
 * Tokens appear anywhere inline: `{台词}` is voiceover; following `@[角色]` (with whitespace or one
 * Chinese/English colon), `{台词}` is that character speaking. Empty dialogue, whitespace-only speakers and malformed speakers
 * (`@[]{…}`, `@[张三]：：{…}`) never form tokens; braces remain descriptions for caller warnings.
 *
 * Deliberate backend difference: **never normalize source text**, only extracted speakers. Highlight tokenizers must reconstruct sources
 * character by character over textareas; normalization would prevent reconstruction. Decision paths (`extractMentions`/
 * `toScriptLines`) receive already normalized `splitScriptLines` inputs, so both sides still agree.
 *
 * Mention/`{` whitespace uses `INLINE_SPACE_RE`: JS `\s` lacks Python `str.isspace()`
 * U+001F (coarser U+001C–U+001E/U+0085 become line breaks through `LINE_BREAK_RE`, never inline;
 * backends remove U+FEFF at normalization, while `\s` matches it here). Added classes make both sets character-identical.
 */

pairs.source: // 嵌套 / 漏闭合：外层 `{` 不成记号，从内层重新扫描。
pairs.translation: // Nested/unclosed braces: outer `{` forms no token; resume scanning inside.

pairs.source: // 写坏的说话人位（`@[]{…}`、`@[张三]：：{…}`）：不静默降级成画外音。
pairs.translation: // Malformed speakers (`@[]{…}`,`@[张三]：：{…}`) never silently degrade to voiceover.

pairs.source: /** 一行里按出现顺序排列的发声记号。 */
pairs.translation: /** Speech tokens in first-appearance order within lines. */

pairs.source: /** 去掉全部发声记号后剩下的画面描述文本——参考图派生按此判定。 */
pairs.translation: /** Visual descriptions after removing all speech tokens; reference-image derivation uses these. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * Python `str.splitlines()` 的换行集合——后端 `text_parser` / `script_preview` 都用它切行。
 * 只按 `\n` 切会把 U+2028 之后的台词记号与上一行粘在一起（粘贴、agent 产出的文本里会出现），
 * 前端据此把说话人算进参考图、后端不算，两条派生路径当场分叉。
 * 带捕获组：`split` 时分隔符原样留在结果里，token 仍可拼回原文。
 *
 * The control characters in the class are deliberate: Python counts the file and
 * group separators as line breaks too, and dropping one reintroduces exactly the
 * front/back divergence this constant exists to remove.
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Python `str.splitlines()` line-break sets, used by backend `text_parser`/`script_preview`.
 * Splitting only on `\n` joins dialogue after U+2028 to previous lines (pasted/agent-generated text can contain this),
 * making frontends include speakers as image references while backends exclude them, diverging derivation immediately.
 * Capturing groups retain delimiters unchanged in `split` results, preserving source reconstruction from tokens.
 *
 * The control characters in the class are deliberate: Python counts the file and
 * group separators as line breaks too, and dropping one reintroduces exactly the
 * front/back divergence this constant exists to remove.
 */

pairs.source: // eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex -- 须显式匹配 U+001C–U+001E，对齐 Python str.splitlines()
pairs.translation: // eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex -- Explicit U+001C–U+001E matching aligns Python str.splitlines()

pairs.source:
/**
 * 按后端同一套换行边界切行（不保留分隔符），行内容已是规范形（见 `normalizeSource`）。
 *
 * 末尾换行不产生空行、空串切出空数组——都与 `splitlines()` 一致；行中间的空行照常保留。
 * 归一不增删换行，行数与下标（`toScriptLines` 的 `sourceLine`）与原文逐行对应。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Split on backend-identical boundaries without retaining delimiters; line contents are canonical (`normalizeSource`).
 *
 * Final newlines add no empty lines; empty strings yield empty arrays, matching `splitlines()`; interior empty lines remain.
 * Normalization never adds/removes breaks, so counts/indexes (`toScriptLines` `sourceLine`) correspond linewise with originals.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * Mention names in first-appearance order, deduplicated — the reference-image
 * derivation. Mirrors `text_parser.py:extract_mentions`, including its rule that
 * **the speaker slot of a speech mark is excluded**: attaching a reference image to
 * a speaker would coax the model into drawing a character who only speaks off-screen.
 * 记号之外的 `@[名称]` 照常进参考图，同一行里两者并存。
 *
 * 名字一律是规范形，去重也按规范形——调用方直接拿去与已归一的资产表 key 判等，不再补归一。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Mention names in first-appearance order, deduplicated: reference-image
 * derivation. Mirrors `text_parser.py:extract_mentions`, including its rule that
 * **the speaker slot of a speech mark is excluded**: attaching a reference image to
 * a speaker would coax the model into drawing a character who only speaks off-screen.
 * Non-token `@[名称]` still enters image references, coexisting on the same lines.
 *
 * Names/deduplication are canonical; callers compare directly against normalized asset-table keys without further normalization.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 台词记号的说话人，按出现顺序去重。镜像后端
 * `lib/script/reference_video/draft_validation.py::dialogue_speakers`——「谁在这个单元里发声」只由
 * 说话人位决定，与 `extractMentions`（画面参考图）互补：一个角色可以只发声不出镜，也可以
 * 只出镜不发声，音色相关的判定一律走本函数。
 *
 * 名字取自 `splitSpeechLine`，已归一到资产名比对坐标系，调用方直接与已归一的资产表 key 判等。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Dialogue-token speakers deduplicated by appearance, mirroring backend
 * `lib/script/reference_video/draft_validation.py::dialogue_speakers`. Speaker slots alone determine
 * who speaks in units, complementing `extractMentions` visual references: characters may speak without appearing, or appear
 * without speaking; timbre-related decisions always use this function.
 *
 * Names from `splitSpeechLine` already use asset comparison coordinates, compared directly against normalized asset keys.
 */

pairs.source: // eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex -- 须显式匹配 Python str.strip() 空白集中的控制字符
pairs.translation: // eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex -- Explicitly match control characters in Python str.strip() whitespace sets

pairs.source:
/**
 * 把资产名归一到项目名称空间的比对坐标系（strip + Unicode NFC）。镜像后端
 * `lib.project.asset_types.asset_name_comparison_key`——两侧必须同一坐标系，否则「后端判已登记、
 * 前端判未登记」（反之亦然），组合字符名（如越南语）在这两侧各自输入法/来源下
 * 尤其容易产出不同编码形式。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Normalize asset names into project-namespace comparison coordinates (strip+Unicode NFC), mirroring backend
 * `lib.project.asset_types.asset_name_comparison_key`. Both sides require identical coordinates, otherwise backend Registered/frontend
 * Unregistered (or vice versa) diverge. Combined-character names (e.g. Vietnamese) particularly easily acquire
 * differing encodings through respective input methods/sources.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 为编辑器高亮构造项目引用名到类型的唯一映射。镜像后端
 * `lib/references/reference_catalog.py::build_reference_catalog` 的名字集合：资产名，加上角色的
 * `本体名/衍生名`（衍生共享本体的类型，见 `docs/adr/0072`）。
 *
 * 无原型字典保证 `__proto__` 等合法资产名可作为普通 key。损坏项目若有同名资产，
 * 按 product → character → scene → prop 的稳定优先级解析。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Unique project-reference-name/type maps for editor highlights, mirroring backend
 * `lib/references/reference_catalog.py::build_reference_catalog` names: asset names plus character
 * `本体名/衍生名` (derivatives share base types; `docs/adr/0072`).
 *
 * Prototype-free dictionaries allow legal names such as `__proto__` as ordinary keys. Corrupt projects with duplicate names
 * resolve by stable product→character→scene→prop precedence.
 */

pairs.source: /** 一个角色形态：本体，或它名下的一个衍生。`asset` 是该形态自己的条目（资产图与描述都取自它）。 */
pairs.translation: /** Character forms: bases or owned derivatives; `asset` is each form own entry, supplying its images/descriptions. */

pairs.source: /** 引用名：本体名，或 `本体名/衍生名`。写进 `@[…]` 与 `characters_in_*` 的就是它。 */
pairs.translation: /** Reference names: base names or `本体名/衍生名`, written into `@[…]`/`characters_in_*`. */

pairs.source: /** 承载该形态的角色条目名。衍生下与 `name` 分叉，本体下相等。 */
pairs.translation: /** Owning character entry names; differ from `name` for derivatives, equal for bases. */

pairs.source: /** 衍生名；本体形态为空串。 */
pairs.translation: /** Derivative names; empty for bases. */

pairs.source: /** 该形态自己的登记条目：本体是角色条目，衍生是 `derivatives` 表里的那条。 */
pairs.translation: /** Registered form entries: character entries for bases, `derivatives` entries for derivatives. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 项目里全部可被引用的角色形态，本体在前、其衍生紧随其后。镜像后端
 * `lib/references/reference_catalog.py::ReferenceCatalog` 对角色类的展开（见 `docs/adr/0072`）：
 * 引用弹窗的候选、头像堆的取图与编辑器高亮都从这一处取名字，不各自遍历 `derivatives`。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * All referenceable project character forms, bases followed immediately by their derivatives. Mirrors backend
 * `lib/references/reference_catalog.py::ReferenceCatalog` character expansion (`docs/adr/0072`):
 * mention candidates/avatar-image stacks/editor highlights source names here, never traversing `derivatives` independently.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 按引用名取角色形态；名字未登记（含「本体在、这个衍生不在」）时返回 undefined。
 * 判等落在资产名比对坐标系上，与 {@link buildMentionLookup} 同口径。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Resolve character forms by reference names; undefined for unregistered names, including existing bases with missing derivatives.
 * Equality uses asset-name comparison coordinates, matching {@link buildMentionLookup}.
 */

pairs.source: /** 引用名的展示形态：衍生显示为 `本体 / 衍生`，本体原样。 */
pairs.translation: /** Display reference names: derivatives as `本体 / 衍生`, bases unchanged. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 无图时占位方块里的首字母：衍生取衍生名。同一角色的多个形态否则是同一个字、同一种底色，
 * 堆在一起分不开。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Initials for imageless placeholder squares use derivative names; otherwise multiple same-character forms would share
 * letters/backgrounds, indistinguishable in stacks.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * supported_durations 输入 / 显示 / 检测的纯函数工具。
 *
 * 设计：所有持久化形态都是 list[int]。本工具负责 UI ↔ list 互转、
 * 检测连续整数集（用于 slider/按钮组渲染选择）、以及格式化展示标签。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Pure supported_durations input/display/detection helpers.
 *
 * All persisted shapes are list[int]. Convert UI ↔ lists,
 * detect consecutive integer sets for slider/button-group rendering, and format display labels.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 解析用户输入的逗号分隔时长文本，支持区间简写。
 *
 * 规则：
 *   - 逗号分隔片段；每段 trim 后过滤空段
 *   - 单值：^\d+$（必须正整数，≤ MAX_SINGLE_VALUE）
 *   - 区间：^(\d+)-(\d+)$；min ≤ max 且跨度 ≤ MAX_RANGE_SPAN
 *   - 输出去重升序
 * @returns 解析得到的 list；输入为纯空白则 null
 * @throws DurationParseError 当存在非法片段或仅由分隔符组成
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Parse user-entered comma-separated durations, supporting range shorthand.
 *
 * Rules:
 *   - Split on commas; trim segments and omit empty ones
 *   - Single values: ^\d+$ (positive integers, ≤ MAX_SINGLE_VALUE)
 *   - Ranges: ^(\d+)-(\d+)$; min ≤ max and span ≤ MAX_RANGE_SPAN
 *   - Deduplicated ascending output
 * @returns Parsed list; null for whitespace-only input
 * @throws DurationParseError For invalid segments or separator-only input
 */

pairs.source: /** 判断列表是否为连续整数集（如 [3,4,5,6,7]），需 ≥2 个元素。 */
pairs.translation: /** Whether lists contain consecutive integers (e.g. [3,4,5,6,7]), requiring ≥2 elements. */

/**
 * Compact list[int] displays, collapsing consecutive runs to "min-max".
 *
 * Example: [3,4,5,7,8,9,10,12] → "3-5, 7-10, 12"
 */
/** UI labels: consecutive ranges → "3-7s"; otherwise → "4, 6, 8s". */

pairs.translation: // Ladders must match backend lib/script/grid/layout.py or batch previews drift from actual enqueued image counts.

pairs.translation: // Broadcast order: cut episode 1 (a.txt beginning), own-source episode 5, cut episode 2 (a.txt later), cut episode 3 (b.txt beginning).

pairs.translation: /** Storyboards (segment / scene / shot) or reference-video units. */

pairs.translation: /** Total episode entry counts. */

pairs.translation: /** Project-relative thumbnails, preferring video thumbnails then storyboards. */

pairs.translation: /** Script entry arrays/ID fields, one per four skeletons. */

pairs.translation: /** Storyboard/video-unit entry IDs (E3S05,E3U2,split E3S05_1); grids (E3G01) and other entries do not use positional references. */

pairs.source: // 供应商配置可变（用户在设置页编辑模型 supported_durations），前端不得持久缓存它——
pairs.translation: // Provider settings change, for example edited supported_durations; frontend must never persistently cache them:

pairs.source: // 每次消费都必须重拉，否则项目设置/向导读到的时长集会陈旧（ADR 0035）。
pairs.translation: // refetch per consumption, avoiding stale project-setting/wizard durations (ADR 0035).

pairs.source: // 内置供应商缓存同理：status/enabled 等可变项陈旧会让模型选择器漏显刚配好的供应商。
pairs.translation: // Same for built-ins: stale status/enabled caches hide newly configured providers.

pairs.source: // 自定义供应商目录无逐模型声明，与服务端 `_resolve_video_caps_for_model` 同口径固定假定
pairs.translation: // Custom catalogs lack per-model declarations; match server `_resolve_video_caps_for_model` assuming

pairs.source: // 有声（soft）——不是「未知」，故不返回 null。
pairs.translation: // audio soft, never unknown/null.

pairs.translation: // Kling v3-omni shape: image-to-video subpaths include switches, reference-video native schemas omit them.

pairs.source: // 逐路径取值：按模型取会让参考生视频放行一个执行期必然被丢弃的开关（用户开了音频拿到无声成片）。
pairs.translation: // Per-path lookup prevents reference-to-video controls necessarily discarded at execution (audio-enabled users receiving silent outputs).

pairs.source: // 自定义供应商无逐模型音轨声明：无信号不收紧，开关保持可控。
pairs.translation: // Custom providers lack per-model audio declarations; do not tighten without signals, leaving toggles controllable.

pairs.source: // 没有覆盖时时长由模型条目给出，前端查不到
pairs.translation: // Without overrides, durations come from catalog entries unavailable to frontends.

pairs.source: /** 事件通知文案的翻译函数，由调用方从 `events` 命名空间取得。 */
pairs.translation: /** Event copy translation, supplied by callers from `events` namespaces. */

pairs.translation: /** Broadcast-order ledgers converting event episode/entry IDs into title · S01. */

pairs.source: // 完成事件：一次生成跑完的信号。同时承担两种用途——
pairs.translation: // Completion events signal completed generation, serving two purposes:

pairs.source: // 一、通知类别（action 本身即类别，与 entity_type 无关）：优先级查表、导航行为、通知文案均不按
pairs.translation: // First, notification categories are actions themselves, independent of entity_type; priority/navigation/copy never split by

pairs.source: //     entity_type 拆分，五类骨架/任务共用同一套判定；
pairs.translation: //     entity_type, sharing rules across five skeleton/task kinds;

pairs.source: // 二、计费信号：生成完成即可能产生供应商费用，命中即重拉成本。
pairs.translation: // Second, billing signals: completed generation may incur provider costs, so refetch costs on matches.

pairs.source: // 条目 ID 带集前缀（E1S01）的实体；资产名是自由文本，形似条目 ID 也按原名显示。
pairs.translation: // Entities whose entry IDs carry episode prefixes (E1S01); asset names remain free text even when resembling IDs.

pairs.source: // 事件携带的稳定 label_key + label_params 是文案真相源；label 是后端按默认语言渲染的兜底，
pairs.translation: // Stable event label_key+label_params are copy truth; label is backend default-language fallback,

pairs.source: // 只在事件来自不认识该 key 的旧发布方时兜住，不参与常规渲染。
pairs.translation: // used only for older publishers without recognized keys, never ordinary rendering.

pairs.source: // 集 ID 与带集前缀的条目 ID 不直接露给创作者：集换成标题（或播出位置），条目换成「标题 · 5」（本集里的当前位置）。
pairs.translation: // Hide raw episode/prefixed entry IDs from creators: episodes become titles/broadcast positions, entries Title · 5 (current episode positions).
