pairs.translation: // Individual-sentence keys derive from action, sharing action categorization with grouped copy.

pairs.source:
/**
 * 应用内链接（Agent 回复里的「跳到这里看」）的格式与解析。链接是普通的应用内路径，新开标签页、复制地址都照常可用：
 *
 * - 剪辑视图：`/app/projects/{项目名}/episodes/{集 ID}?view=edit&tl={剪辑时间线ID}&t={秒}`
 *   `tl` 与 `t` 均可省略；`t` 是该剪辑时间线上的全局时间（秒），落在哪个片段由时间线决定。
 * - 视频单元预览：`/app/projects/{项目名}/episodes/{集 ID}?unit={单元ID}&t={秒}`
 *   打开该单元的预览；带 `t` 时从 `t` 开始播放。`t` 可省略，是该单元视频自身的时间（秒，从视频开头算起）；单元 ID 即脚本里的 `segment_id` / `shot_id` / `scene_id` / `unit_id`。
 *
 * 集 ID 是项目详情 `episodes[].episode`，不是播出位置。项目名按路径段做 URL 编码。两种格式不要混写：带 `view=edit` 时 `unit` 不生效，`t` 按剪辑时间线上的全局时间处理。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * In-app links for Agent reply navigation, ordinary application paths supporting new tabs/copied addresses:
 *
 * - Edit views: `/app/projects/{项目名}/episodes/{集 ID}?view=edit&tl={剪辑时间线ID}&t={秒}`
 *   `tl` / `t` are optional; `t` is global timeline seconds, with timelines choosing clips.
 * - Video-unit previews: `/app/projects/{项目名}/episodes/{集 ID}?unit={单元ID}&t={秒}`
 *   Open unit previews, with `t`, starting at `t`. Optional `t` is seconds from that unit video's beginning; IDs are script `segment_id` / `shot_id` / `scene_id` / `unit_id`.
 *
 * Episode IDs come from project-detail `episodes[].episode`, never broadcast positions. Encode project names as URL segments. Never mix formats: `view=edit` ignores `unit`, interpreting `t` as global timeline time.
 */

pairs.source: /** 规范化后的完整站内地址（以 `/` 开头，含原有查询参数），用作 `<a href>`，新开标签页也落到同一处。 */
pairs.translation: /** Normalized complete application URLs (starting `/`, preserving queries), used for `<a href>` so new tabs reach the same locations. */

pairs.source: /** 要跳转的路径与查询。单元链接的 `unit`、`t` 在这里已去掉：它们是一次性的定位指令，不留在地址栏里。 */
pairs.translation: /** Target paths/queries; unit-link `unit`/`t` are removed here as one-shot location commands never retained in address bars. */

pairs.source: /** 链接指向的视频单元；起始时间缺省为 null。`project` 是链接所在项目的名称（已解码），项目名无法解码时为 null。 */
pairs.translation: /** Linked video units; omitted start times are null. `project` is decoded project names, null when decoding fails. */

pairs.source: /** 非负的十进制秒数；其余写法（负数、科学计数法、空串）一律视为没有写。 */
pairs.translation: /** Nonnegative decimal seconds; all other forms (negative, scientific notation, empty) count as omitted. */

pairs.source: /** 取集页路径 `/app/projects/{项目名}/...` 里的项目名并解码；解码失败返回 null。 */
pairs.translation: /** Extract/decode project names from episode paths `/app/projects/{项目名}/...`; return null on decode failures. */

pairs.source: /** 同源且在 `/app` 之下的链接才算应用内链接；其余（含协议相对地址、其他域名）返回 null，由调用方按外链处理。 */
pairs.translation: /** Only same-origin links under `/app` are in-app; others (including protocol-relative/other domains) return null for caller external-link handling. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 本会话已因加载失败整页刷新过的 chunk（按导出名记录），防止新入口仍拉不到时无限刷新。
 * 按 chunk 记录：别的 chunk 加载成功不代表失败的那个已经恢复，不能借此解除它的刷新限制。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Chunks already causing whole-page refreshes this session, keyed by exports, preventing infinite refreshes when new entrypoints still fail.
 * Per-chunk records: unrelated successes cannot prove failed chunks recovered, never lifting their refresh limits.
 */

pairs.source: /** 发起刷新后页面仍未离开、判定刷新被拦下的等待时长。 */
pairs.translation: /** Wait after reload requests before unchanged pages mean blocked refreshes. */

pairs.source: /** 整页刷新的实现，测试替换；默认 `window.location.reload()`。 */
pairs.translation: /** Whole-page reload implementation, replaceable in tests, default `window.location.reload()`. */

pairs.source: /** 发起刷新后等待多久仍未离开页面，即视为刷新被拦下；测试缩短。 */
pairs.translation: /** Wait for page departures before classifying reloads blocked; tests shorten this. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 发起整页刷新并判断它是否真的会发生。
 *
 * 有未保存修改时离开拦截会在 `beforeunload` 里 preventDefault，浏览器弹出离开确认，
 * 用户可以选择留下，刷新就不会发生。这里在刷新前最后注册一个 `beforeunload` 监听：
 * 事件未被拦下说明页面正在离开，返回 true；被拦下或事件未触发时等待一段时间，
 * 页面仍在则返回 false。确认框会阻塞主线程，计时器在用户作答之后才会到期。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Request whole-page reloads and determine whether they occur.
 *
 * Unsaved-change guards preventDefault in `beforeunload`, opening browser confirmations;
 * users choosing Stay block reloads. Register the last `beforeunload` listener immediately before reload:
 * unprevented events mean departure, returning true; prevented/absent events wait briefly,
 * returning false if pages remain. Confirmation blocks main threads, so timers expire only after user answers.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 按命名导出懒加载组件，配合 `<Suspense>` 把非首屏页面拆进独立 chunk。
 *
 * chunk 拉取失败多发生在新版本部署之后：页面仍是旧入口，引用的带 hash 文件名已被替换，
 * 请求返回 404。此时整页刷新一次换上新入口；同一会话内该 chunk 刷新后仍失败，错误照常抛给
 * React，不再刷新。该 chunk 之后加载成功即清除它的标记，下次部署后的失败仍可刷新一次。刷新被
 * 离开确认拦下（用户为保护未保存修改选择留下）时同样抛出错误并清除标记。
 *
 * 抛出的错误由外层 `LazyBoundary`（`components/shared/LazyBoundary`）接住，显示加载失败与
 * 「重新加载」；使用处必须包在它里面，否则错误会卸载整个应用根节点。
 *
 * 返回值额外带 `preload()`：已知马上要进入该页面时（如引导即将跨到设置页）提前拉取 chunk，
 * 与渲染时的加载共用同一个请求；预取失败不报错，留给渲染时按上述规则处理。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Lazy-load named exports with `<Suspense>`, splitting noninitial pages into separate chunks.
 *
 * Chunk failures commonly follow deployments: old entries reference replaced hash filenames,
 * returning 404. Refresh whole pages once for new entries; same-session repeated failures propagate to
 * React without another reload. Later successful loads clear this chunk's marker, allowing next-deployment refreshes. Reloads blocked by
 * leave confirmations protecting unsaved edits also throw and clear markers.
 *
 * Outer `LazyBoundary` (`components/shared/LazyBoundary`) catches failures, showing errors/
 * Reload. Call sites must wrap boundaries or errors unmount whole application roots.
 *
 * Returned `preload()` fetches chunks before imminent navigation (onboarding crossing to settings),
 * sharing render requests. Prefetch failures stay silent, deferring handling to rendering rules above.
 */

pairs.source: // 失败的请求不缓存，下次渲染或预取重新发起
pairs.translation: // Never cache failed requests; later renders/prefetches try again.

pairs.source: // 刷新期间保持挂起，界面停在 Suspense 的占位上，不闪错误
pairs.translation: // Remain suspended during reloads, retaining Suspense placeholders without error flashes.

pairs.source: // 刷新被拦下，本页不会换新：清除标记，让之后的失败仍能刷新，错误交给边界显示
pairs.translation: // Blocked refreshes retain old pages; clear markers for later refresh attempts, displaying errors through boundaries.

pairs.source: // ISO 字符串若没有显式时区后缀（Z / ±HH(:MM)），按 UTC 处理避免浏览器歧义。
pairs.translation: // Treat ISO strings without explicit timezone suffixes (Z / ±HH(:MM)) as UTC to avoid browser ambiguity.

pairs.source: // 时间戳解析规则在时刻展示与时长计算之间共用，故导出。
pairs.translation: // Export timestamp parsing shared by instant displays/duration calculations.

pairs.source: // 本地时刻 HH:mm，用于同一天内的对话流；解析失败返回 null 由调用方兜底
pairs.translation: // Local HH:mm for same-day conversation streams; return null on parse failures for caller fallbacks.

pairs.source: // 紧凑本地时间 MM/DD HH:mm，用于信息密集的列表/标题；解析失败返回 null 由调用方兜底
pairs.translation: // Compact local MM/DD HH:mm for dense lists/titles; return null on parse failures for caller fallbacks.

pairs.source: // 与当前相差不足一分钟（含时钟偏差造成的略晚于当前）算「刚刚」；解析失败返回 false。
pairs.translation: // Differences below one minute (including slight future times from clock skew) mean Just now; parse failures return false.

pairs.source: // 「刚刚」要嵌进整句话，措辞因句子而异，由调用方各自选文案，不交给 Intl 的「现在」。
pairs.translation: // Just now appears within sentences with context-dependent wording; callers choose copy rather than Intl Now.

pairs.source: // 相对当前的粗粒度时间（「3 小时前」），按界面语言成文；不足一分钟交给 Intl 成文（「现在」），解析失败返回 null。
pairs.translation: // Coarse relative times (3 hours ago) follow UI languages; Intl handles sub-minute Now; parse failures return null.

pairs.source: // 需要「刚刚」的调用方先用 isJustNow 判断。
pairs.translation: // Callers needing Just now first check isJustNow.

pairs.source: // 行内确认区域的退出事件（docs/standards/frontend.md「行内确认」）。打开时聚焦哪个按钮、交还焦点给谁由调用方决定。
pairs.translation: // Inline-confirm exit events (docs/standards/frontend.md Inline confirmation). Callers choose initial/restored focus.

pairs.source: /** 绑在区域内的按钮上：容器不是交互元素，jsx-a11y 不允许在它上面挂键盘事件；焦点一离开容器确认态就结束，Esc 不会落在容器外。 */
pairs.translation: /** Bind buttons within regions: noninteractive containers cannot have keyboard handlers under jsx-a11y; focus departure ends confirmation, so Esc never originates outside. */

pairs.source: // 不让 Esc 继续冒泡关掉所在的悬浮层
pairs.translation: // Stop Esc bubbling from closing containing overlays.

pairs.source: /** 焦点离开区域即退出，焦点留在用户去的地方。 */
pairs.translation: /** Exit on focus departure, leaving focus at chosen destinations. */

pairs.source: // 焦点仍在区域内，或整个窗口失焦（relatedTarget 为空且文档已不持有焦点）：确认态保留
pairs.translation: // Retain confirmation while focus stays inside, or windows blur (null relatedTarget and unfocused documents).

pairs.source: /** 点区域内的提示文字不让焦点落到 body：按钮（含按钮内的图标、文字节点）照常接收焦点。 */
pairs.translation: /** Notice-text clicks retain focus off body; buttons and their icon/text nodes receive focus normally. */

pairs.source: // 条目按本集里的当前位置称呼，排列故意与 ID 序号错开。
pairs.translation: // Entries use current episode positions; deliberately offset ordering from ID numbers.

pairs.source: // 后端 label 只是默认语言渲染结果，界面文案以稳定 key + 参数为准。
pairs.translation: // Backend label is default-language rendering only; UI copy follows stable keys/parameters.

pairs.source: // 四种骨架 created 分组的标题名词须与条目名词一致：三种分镜骨架 / 视频单元。

pairs.translation: /** Filter skills by text after /, matching names/descriptions/localized display names. */

pairs.translation: // Backends already exclude skills unavailable for direct user invocation.

pairs.source: /** 输入框外框：菜单浮在它的上方，与它同宽。 */
pairs.translation: /** Input frames: menus float above them at matching widths. */

pairs.source: /** 已筛选的技能；为空时不显示菜单。 */
pairs.translation: /** Filtered skills; empty lists hide menus. */

pairs.source: /** 当前高亮的技能名，由输入框的方向键驱动。 */
pairs.translation: /** Highlighted skill names, driven by input arrow keys. */

pairs.source: /** 列表与高亮项渲染后的 DOM id，供输入框的 aria-controls 与 aria-activedescendant 引用。 */
pairs.translation: /** Rendered list/highlight DOM IDs for input aria-controls/aria-activedescendant. */

pairs.source: // SlashCommandMenu — 输入「/」时浮在输入框上方的技能菜单。
pairs.translation: // SlashCommandMenu: skill menus above inputs when typing /.

pairs.source: // 焦点始终留在输入框里：方向键与回车由输入框处理，菜单只负责展示与指针选择。
pairs.translation: // Focus stays inside inputs, which handle arrows/Enter; menus only present/pointer-select.

pairs.source: // cmdk 给列表与选项生成自己的 id，并在自己的提交里异步更新选中项；输入框要引用它们，只能等 DOM
pairs.translation: // cmdk generates list/option IDs and updates selections asynchronously during its own commits; inputs can reference IDs only after DOM

pairs.source: // 落定后读出来。弹层在打开后的下一次提交才挂上列表，所以列表元素记在 state 里，挂上后监听变化
pairs.translation: // settlement. Popovers mount lists on the next commit after opening; keep list elements in state and observe changes after mounting.

pairs.source: // react-doctor-disable-next-line react-doctor/no-prop-callback-in-effect -- 回传的是 cmdk 自己生成的 DOM id（外部系统），本组件没有可提升的 state，只能在 DOM 落定后读出并通知输入框
pairs.translation: // react-doctor-disable-next-line react-doctor/no-prop-callback-in-effect -- Return cmdk-generated external-system DOM IDs; this component has no liftable state and must read settled DOM then notify inputs

pairs.source: /* cmdk 列表的可访问名称取自 label，默认是英文「Suggestions」 */
pairs.translation: /* cmdk list accessible names come from label, default English Suggestions. */

pairs.source: // 按下时不让输入框失焦，选择后光标仍在原处
pairs.translation: // Prevent input blur on pointer down, keeping carets in place after selection.

pairs.source: // Agent 自带的「其他」选项由自由输入框代替，不再单独列出
pairs.translation: // Replace Agent-supplied Other options with free inputs, never list separately.

pairs.source: /** 按 Agent 提问的原文回传答案；多选与自由输入合并成一句，用逗号分隔。 */
pairs.translation: /** Return answers against original Agent questions; combine multiple choices/free text into comma-separated sentences. */

pairs.source: // AgentQuestionnaire — Agent 提问时占用输入框的位置。
pairs.translation: // AgentQuestionnaire occupies inputs while Agent asks questions.

pairs.source: // 头部与底部按钮固定，只有题目区滚动；高度上限是 Agent 面板高度的 70%，
pairs.translation: // Fixed headers/footer buttons; only questions scroll, capped at 70% of Agent-panel height;

pairs.source: // 下方有排队消息托盘时与托盘分用这部分高度，问卷降到 50%；展开的待办清单再占去空间时继续压缩题目区。
pairs.translation: // queued-message trays share this space, reducing questionnaires to 50%; expanded todos further squeeze question regions.

pairs.source: // 数字键选择选项，「其他」写在每题末尾的输入框里。
pairs.translation: // Number keys select options; Other uses inputs at question ends.

pairs.source: // 原语的进度名称与朗读文字写死为英文，按界面语言覆盖
pairs.translation: // Primitive progress names/announcements hardcode English; override with UI languages.

pairs.source: /* 只有题目区滚动，头部与按钮始终可见 */
pairs.translation: /* Only questions scroll; headers/buttons remain visible. */

pairs.source: /** 把输入框里的内容再发一次（启动失败后的「重试」）。 */
pairs.translation: /** Resend input contents (Retry after startup failures). */

pairs.source: /** 等待回答或发送请求在途时锁定输入。 */
pairs.translation: /** Lock inputs while awaiting answers or pending send requests. */

pairs.source: /** 运行中且输入为空：发送按钮换成「停止」；有内容时仍是发送。 */
pairs.translation: /** Running with empty inputs: replace Send with Stop; nonempty inputs still Send. */

pairs.source: /** 发送请求在途：发送按钮转圈。 */
pairs.translation: /** Pending send requests: Send buttons spin. */

pairs.source: /** 提问占用输入框位置时隐藏输入框；仍保持挂载，已输入的文字与附件不丢。排队消息托盘照常显示。 */
pairs.translation: /** Hide inputs while questions occupy their positions; keep mounted to retain text/attachments. Queued-message trays remain visible. */

pairs.source: /** 发送消息；受理后清掉已发出的文字与附件，未受理时保留供重试。 */
pairs.translation: /** Send messages; clear submitted text/attachments after acceptance, retaining unaccepted messages for retries. */

pairs.source: /** 编辑或删除一条排队消息；编辑撤回成功时内容经 store 的 composerAppends 退回输入框。 */
pairs.translation: /** Edit/delete queued messages; successful edit recalls return contents through store composerAppends. */

pairs.source: /** 重新发送一条「未发送」消息。 */
pairs.translation: /** Resend Unsent messages. */

pairs.source: /** 立即发送一条排队消息。 */
pairs.translation: /** Immediately send queued messages. */

pairs.source: /** 光标左侧以「/」开头、尚未输入空格的一段文字：返回「/」的位置与其后的筛选词。 */
pairs.translation: /** Text immediately left of carets starting with / without spaces yet: return slash positions and following filters. */

pairs.source: /** 发送受理后去掉已发出的文字。发送途中编辑退回的内容追加在它后面，保留下来。 */
pairs.translation: /** Remove sent text after acceptance; recalled edits appended during sends remain afterward. */

pairs.source: // AgentComposer — Agent 面板底部的输入框。
pairs.translation: // AgentComposer: input at Agent-panel bottoms.

pairs.source: // 排队消息托盘在输入框正上方；图片附件在输入框顶行，可逐个移除；输入「/」时
pairs.translation: // Queued-message trays sit directly above inputs; individually removable image attachments sit atop inputs; typing /

pairs.source: // 技能菜单浮在输入框上方。回复进行中也可以发送，发送与停止共用一个按钮。
pairs.translation: // opens skill menus above inputs. Sending remains available during replies; Send/Stop share buttons.

pairs.source: // 退回的排队消息可能让图片超过上限：全部保留，移除多出的才能发送
pairs.translation: // Recalled queued messages may exceed image limits: retain all, requiring removal of excess before sending.

pairs.source: // 只清掉这次发出的文字与图片：发送途中编辑退回的内容不在这次发送里，留给用户再发
pairs.translation: // Clear only text/images in this send; edits recalled during sends remain for users to send again.

pairs.source: // 外部投递的一次性预填（如分集空态的入口经 store.input 投递）：覆盖输入框后清空 store 字段，避免重复预填
pairs.translation: // External one-shot prefills (e.g. episode-empty-state entries through store.input) replace inputs, then clear store fields to avoid repetition.

pairs.source: // 延后到微任务清空，避免在 zustand 订阅通知期间嵌套 dispatch
pairs.translation: // Defer clearing to microtasks, avoiding nested dispatch during zustand subscription notifications.

pairs.source: // 面板可能同帧刚被打开（inert 尚未移除），等一帧再聚焦
pairs.translation: // Panels may have opened this frame with inert still applied; wait one frame before focusing.

pairs.source: // 编辑排队消息退回的内容：文字接在已有文字之后另起一行，图片接在已有附件之后，都不覆盖
pairs.translation: // Recalled queue edits append text on new lines after existing text/images after current attachments, overwriting neither.

pairs.source: // 延后到微任务取走，避免在 zustand 订阅通知期间嵌套 dispatch
pairs.translation: // Defer consumption to microtasks, avoiding nested dispatch during zustand subscription notifications.

pairs.source: // 还没移动过时菜单高亮的是第一项
pairs.translation: // Menus highlight first entries before movement.

pairs.source: // 只关菜单；阻止默认行为，外壳不会因这次 Esc 收起面板
pairs.translation: // Close menus only; prevent defaults so this Esc cannot collapse shell panels.

pairs.source: /* 问卷替换的只是输入框：托盘在外，提问期间仍可编辑、删除排队消息 */
pairs.translation: /* Questionnaires replace inputs only; external trays still permit queue editing/deletion during questions. */

pairs.source: /* 拖入图片时整个输入框高亮；高亮画在外层，不改输入框原语的样式 */
pairs.translation: /* Dragged images highlight entire inputs; highlight outer wrappers without changing input primitives. */

pairs.source: /* 随内容撑高，上限是 Agent 面板高度的 40%，超出后在框内滚动 */
pairs.translation: /* Expand with content, capped at 40% of Agent-panel height, scrolling internally above caps. */

pairs.source: // 按浏览器 URL 解析规则归一：去掉首尾 C0 控制符与空白、剔除中间的制表与换行后取协议。
pairs.translation: // Normalize browser URLs: trim edge C0 controls/whitespace, remove interior tabs/newlines, then inspect protocols.

pairs.source: // 链接按钮不带 href，地址只保存在点击回调里，DOM 属性检查看不到；PAYLOADS 不含允许的链接，完整渲染后不应出现可点击元素。
pairs.translation: // Link buttons lack href, keeping URLs in click callbacks invisible to DOM-attribute checks; PAYLOADS contains no permitted links, so full rendering must expose no clickable elements.

pairs.source: // 等实际按需模块加载完成，再断言 Markdown 结构，不把加载耗时计入查询超时。
pairs.translation: // Wait for actual lazy modules before Markdown-structure assertions, excluding loading time from query timeouts.

pairs.source: // 前段中不完整链接渲染为占位链接按钮，点击后既不打开确认框也不打开窗口。
pairs.translation: // Incomplete prefix links render placeholder buttons; clicking opens neither confirmation nor windows.

pairs.source: // 挡掉 jsdom 的真实导航
pairs.translation: // Prevent real jsdom navigation.

pairs.source: // jsdom 没有布局：消息区的视口按 400px 高、每条消息按 300px 高打桩，滚动位置按元素记住，
pairs.translation: // jsdom has no layout: stub message viewports at 400px, messages at 300px, retaining scroll positions per element;

pairs.source: // scrollTo 直接写入并派发 scroll 事件。
pairs.translation: // scrollTo writes directly and dispatches scroll events.

pairs.source: // 没选就前进：留在原题并提示
pairs.translation: // Advancing without selection remains on current questions with hints.

pairs.source: // 历史视图打开时输入框仍可用
pairs.translation: // Inputs remain available in History views.

pairs.source: // 删除成功由返回值告知，不看列表此刻是否已经去掉这一条
pairs.translation: // Return values establish successful deletion, regardless of whether lists already removed entries.

pairs.source: // 撤回成功时 hook 把内容交给输入框
pairs.translation: // Successful recalls let hooks return contents to inputs.

pairs.source: // 第二条的编辑还在等撤回答复时发出输入框里的内容；答复在发送受理前到达，内容追加进输入框
pairs.translation: // Send inputs while second-message editing awaits recall; recall returns before send acceptance and appends contents.

pairs.source: // 只清掉已发出的文字和图片，发送途中退回的内容留在输入框
pairs.translation: // Clear sent text/images only, retaining contents recalled during sends.

pairs.source: // 删除不可撤销：先在这一行原地确认，焦点落在取消上，误按 Enter 不会删除
pairs.translation: // Irreversible deletion first confirms inline, focusing Cancel to prevent accidental Enter deletion.

pairs.source: // 退出确认后焦点交还删除按钮，键盘用户不会掉到 body
pairs.translation: // Exiting confirmation returns focus to Delete, never body for keyboard users.

pairs.source: // Tab 离开确认区域：确认态结束，焦点留在用户去的地方
pairs.translation: // Tab out exits confirmation, preserving focus at user destinations.

pairs.source: // 点区域内的提示文字不算离开；点区域外不可聚焦的消息文字算离开
pairs.translation: // Clicking internal hint text stays inside; clicking external nonfocusable message text leaves.

pairs.source: // 撤回没能移出消息时这一行还在：确认态不退出，焦点回到取消，可以重试或取消
pairs.translation: // Failed recall leaves messages/rows in confirmation, returns focus to Cancel and permits retry/cancel.

pairs.source: // 未发送的消息不在 CLI 队列里，没有轮次可打断：只有发送，没有立即发送
pairs.translation: // Unsent messages are outside CLI queues without interruptible turns; offer Send only, never Send now.

pairs.source: // jsdom 没有布局：托盘按 160px 高、每条按 40px 高打桩，滚动位置按元素记住
pairs.translation: // jsdom lacks layout; stub trays at 160px/items at 40px, retaining per-element scroll positions.

pairs.source: // 用户把托盘滚回顶部后，最前面的消息被接纳：不跳动；再发一条：滚到新消息
pairs.translation: // After users scroll trays to tops, accepting first messages must not jump; new sends scroll to new messages.

pairs.source: // 立即发送把末尾那条排到最前：快照重排不是追加，滚到顶部露出它
pairs.translation: // Send now moves final messages first; snapshot reordering is not append, so scroll to tops to reveal them.

pairs.source: // 上翻：滚轮表明是用户在滚动，跟随随之停止
pairs.translation: // Scroll upward: wheels establish user scrolling and stop following.

pairs.source: /** 打开「导出项目」弹窗并选择归档范围。 */
pairs.translation: /** Open Export project and choose archive scopes. */

pairs.source: // 集 ID 与播出顺序不同：ID 3 排第一，ID 1 排第二且没有标题
pairs.translation: // IDs differ from broadcast order: 3 first, 1 second without titles.

pairs.source: // 浏览器前进/后退等场景会复用同一个 GlobalHeader 实例切到演示项目——已打开的
pairs.translation: // Browser Forward/Back may reuse GlobalHeader into demos; open exports

pairs.source: // 导出弹窗须随之关闭，不能继续展示可点击的导出操作
pairs.translation: // must close, never retaining clickable writes.

pairs.source: // 对话框打开时记下的是项目 A；经浏览器前进/后退复用同一个 GlobalHeader 切到项目 B 后，
pairs.translation: // Dialogs captured project A; reused headers navigating B through browser history

pairs.source: // 弹窗须随之关闭，不能让选定范围后导出的仍是 A
pairs.translation: // must close them, preventing later scope selection exporting A.

pairs.source: // 说明写进徽标本身，读屏不依赖弹层；徽标可聚焦，聚焦时弹出同一段说明
pairs.translation: // Badges carry explanations directly for screen readers, focusable with identical focus hints.

pairs.source: // 项目设置在项目切换器里；齿轮在项目内也只通往全局设置
pairs.translation: // Project settings live in switchers; gears always open globals, even in projects.

pairs.source: // 导出失败记入工作区通知，事后可在通知中心回看
pairs.translation: // Export failures persist workspace notifications for later review.

pairs.source: /** 对话框提示里「打开『集名』的剪辑视图」链接指向的集；不传时只显示成片在剪辑视图导出的说明。 */
pairs.translation: /** Episode targeted by dialog links to Open episode editing; omitting it shows only the explanation that finished videos export from editing views. */

pairs.source: /** 打开导出范围对话框，选定范围后导出 `projectName`。 */
pairs.translation: /** Open export-scope dialogs, then export `projectName` after selection. */

pairs.source: /** 关闭尚未选定范围的对话框，如切到别的项目或演示项目时。 */
pairs.translation: /** Close dialogs awaiting scope selection, e.g. when switching projects or entering demos. */

pairs.source: /** 正在为哪个项目请求导出；下载开始后复位。 */
pairs.translation: /** Project currently requesting export; reset once downloads start. */

pairs.source: /** 导出范围对话框与诊断对话框，渲染在调用方组件树里。 */
pairs.translation: /** Export-scope and diagnostic dialogs, rendered in caller component trees. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 导出项目 ZIP：工作区顶栏与大厅卡片菜单共用。选定范围后由浏览器下载；顺利开始时不提示，
 * 导出包带诊断时提示条数并列出诊断，失败时提示原因并记入工作区通知。
 */
/** 收为 56px 图标栏：只显示导航图标与集序号，名称在悬停或聚焦时显示。 */
pairs.translation: /** Collapse to 56px icon rails, showing navigation/episode positions, with names on hover/focus. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 工作区侧栏：上方是工作区导航（项目概览、分集、角色、场景、道具，广告项目另有商品、没有分集），
 * 下方是分集列表（搜索、排序与每集的操作）。宽度由外壳的调宽手柄决定；折叠时收为图标栏。
 */
/** 新建一集对话框：undefined 为关闭，null 放在末尾，数字为插在这一集之后。 */
pairs.translation: /** New-episode dialogs: undefined closed, null append, numbers insert after episodes. */

pairs.source: // 广告/短片项目恒单集：隐藏「集」语义（标题/计数/搜索/添加），直达唯一视频
pairs.translation: // Ads/short films are single episodes; hide episode titles/count/search/add, navigating sole videos directly.

pairs.source: // 演示项目没有服务端侧数据，「分集」入口与添加菜单隐藏（导航其余项与分集列表照常渲染）
pairs.translation: // Demos lack backend data, hiding episode-management/add entries while preserving other navigation/lists.

pairs.source: // 删的是正在看的那一集时回到「分集」视图
pairs.translation: // Deleting current episodes returns to Episodes views.

pairs.source: // 演示项目后端不存在，广告/短片恒单集、不经分集：隐藏入口而非渲染必然报错或无意义的页面
pairs.translation: // Missing demo backends and single-episode ads bypass episode management; hide failing/meaningless entries instead of rendering them.

pairs.source: // 商品资产仅广告/短片项目使用（v1 单商品设定），其余模式隐藏入口
pairs.translation: // Product assets are ad/short-film only, v1 single-product design; hide elsewhere.

pairs.source: // 演示项目没有服务端文件可列
pairs.translation: // Demos lack server files to list.

pairs.source: // 集页 /episodes/:id 由下方分集列表高亮，「分集」只在分集视图本身高亮
pairs.translation: // Episode /episodes/:id highlights come from lists below; Episodes highlights only management views.

pairs.source: // 播出位置按完整账本的排列算，过滤不改变它；搜索按标题与播出位置匹配，集 ID 不参与。
pairs.translation: // Broadcast positions follow full ledgers, unchanged by filters; searches use titles/positions, never IDs.

pairs.source: // ad 隐藏搜索框，残留的 search state 不参与过滤，避免唯一视频入口被吞
pairs.translation: // Ads hide search; ignore residual search state so sole-video entries remain visible.

pairs.source: /* 图标栏不显示搜索框，按看不见的搜索词过滤会让集无故消失 */
pairs.translation: /* Icon rails hide search fields; invisible filters must never make episodes disappear. */

pairs.source: /** 图标栏里的一项：只显示图标或集序号，名称经悬停或聚焦的提示显示，读屏读完整名称。 */
pairs.translation: /** Icon-rail items show icons/episode positions, names through hover/focus hints and complete screen-reader labels. */

pairs.source: // 只预填不发送
pairs.translation: // Prefill only, never send.

pairs.source:
/**
 * 工作区顶栏，三段：
 * - 左：回到项目大厅 + 项目切换器（演示项目另带「演示 · 只读」徽标）
 * - 中：ProjectStatusBar（集进度与项目层的下一步；数据升级失败时是迁移重试）
 * - 右：通知 / 使用记录 / 导出 / 资产库 / 全局设置 / Agent 面板开关
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Workspace headers in three sections:
 * - Left: project lobby + switcher (demos add Demo · Readonly badges)
 * - Center: ProjectStatusBar (episode progress/project next steps, or migration retries after upgrade failures)
 * - Right: notifications / usage / export / library / global settings / Agent-panel toggle
 */

pairs.source: // 导出提示里的剪辑视图链接：在集页时指向当前集，否则指向播出顺序上的第一集；文案用集名。
pairs.translation: // Export editing-view links target current episodes on episode pages, otherwise first broadcast-order episodes; use titles in copy.

pairs.source: // 演示项目在后端没有用量记录，入口整个不渲染。demoMode 在演示→真实切换时先于 store
pairs.translation: // Demos lack backend usage. demoMode becomes false before stores during demo→real switches;

pairs.source: // 变为 false，currentProjectName 单独判一次兜住这一帧仍读到旧演示项目名的窗口。
pairs.translation: // separately check currentProjectName while it still holds old demos.

pairs.source: // 导出对话框打开期间切到别的项目或演示项目（如浏览器前进 / 后退复用同一路由实例）时随即关闭：
pairs.translation: // Project/demo switches while export dialogs open close them immediately, including reused history-route instances:

pairs.source: // 对话框在打开时记下了当时的项目，留着会在选定范围后导出上一个项目；触发按钮已按 demoMode
pairs.translation: // dialogs captured old projects and would export them after scope selection. Disabled triggers follow demoMode,

pairs.source: // 禁用，但已打开的对话框不受影响，仍可点击「导出」。
pairs.translation: // but existing dialogs otherwise remain clickable.

pairs.source: // 入口的数据随项目走：切到别的项目或演示项目时清空上一项目的用量，并收起悬浮层。
pairs.translation: // Project-bound usage clears old data/closes overlays on project/demo switches.

pairs.source: // 底部入口不随搜索词过滤
pairs.translation: // Bottom entries ignore search filters.

pairs.source: /** 完整账本（播出顺序）。 */
pairs.translation: /** Complete broadcast-order ledgers. */

pairs.source: /** 搜索过滤后要显示的集与它们的播出位置。 */
pairs.translation: /** Search-filtered episodes/positions. */

pairs.source: /** 搜索过滤时只显示部分集，不能调整顺序。 */
pairs.translation: /** Partial search results cannot reorder episodes. */

pairs.source: /** 把一集移到 `after` 之后（null 为最前）；提交与刷新完成后 resolve，失败时由调用方提示。 */
pairs.translation: /** Move episodes after `after`, null first; resolve after commit/refresh, callers notify failures. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 侧栏的集列表：拖动把手，或聚焦把手后用空格与方向键调整播出顺序；菜单里有前移、后移、
 * 在这一集之后新建和删除这一集。切出集之间按源文位置排列，违背这一顺序的落点不接受拖放。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Episode rails: drag handles, or focus then Space/arrows to reorder; menus offer forward/back,
 * create-after/delete. Cut episodes retain source order, rejecting incompatible drops.
 */

pairs.source: // 移动提交到刷新完成之间先按新顺序显示，松手后条目不会弹回原处再跳过去。这段时间里不接受新的
pairs.translation: // Display new order between submission/refetch to avoid snap-back then jumps. Reject further moves

pairs.source: // 移动：校验与提交仍按 store 里的旧顺序，叠加的移动会算错落点。把手不禁用，键盘放下后焦点留在原处。
pairs.translation: // while stores still hold old order. Keep handles enabled so keyboard-drop focus stays put.

pairs.source: // 不可行的移动同样交给调用方：它会提示切出集为什么不能移到这里
pairs.translation: // Invalid moves still reach callers, explaining cut-episode placement refusals.

pairs.source: // 把手盖在集序号上，悬停或聚焦时出现
pairs.translation: // Handles overlay episode positions, appearing on hover/focus.

pairs.source: /** 手柄调整的面板，用来读取当前宽度。 */
pairs.translation: /** Panel resized by this handle, for reading current widths. */

pairs.source: /** 面板在手柄的哪一侧：`before` 是左侧的侧栏，向右拖变宽；`after` 是右侧的 Agent 面板，向左拖变宽。 */
pairs.translation: /** Panel side: `before` is the left sidebar, widened by dragging right; `after` is the right Agent panel, widened by dragging left. */

pairs.source: /** 按方向键后面板应调到的宽度，由调用方落到面板上并记住。 */
pairs.translation: /** Target width after arrow keys; callers apply it to panels and remember it. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 工作区的调宽手柄：指针拖动与双击复位由面板库处理（复位到面板的 defaultSize）；方向键每次移动 16px，
 * 库默认按面板组宽度的 5%。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Workspace resize handles: the panel library handles pointer dragging and double-click reset (to panel defaultSize); arrow keys move 16px each time,
 * while the library defaults to 5% of panel-group width.
 */

pairs.source: // 库在手柄元素上直接监听 keydown 并先检查 defaultPrevented；React 的捕获阶段处理器先于它执行。
pairs.translation: // The library listens for keydown directly on handles and checks defaultPrevented first; React capture handlers run before it.

pairs.source:
/**
 * 剧集卡上的两个数字都来自项目摘要，口径是产物清单：可用 = current ∪ stale，
 * stale 另计。工作台读的是同一份计数，两处不得各说各话。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Both card numbers use project-summary manifests: usable = current ∪ stale,
 * with stale counted separately. Workbenches share counts; neither may contradict.
 */

pairs.source: // item_count 与 videos.total 刻意取不同值：读错字段的实现会显示 4/4 或裸 4。
pairs.translation: // Deliberately different item_count/videos.total catches wrong-field displays such as 4/4 or bare 4.

pairs.source: // stale 不从可用里扣：4 件视频全部可用，另有 3 件产物比当前内容旧
pairs.translation: // Stale remains usable: four videos usable, three older than current contents.

pairs.source: // 名词进正文而不是 title：触屏没有悬停，读屏也不必依赖 tooltip
pairs.translation: // Put nouns in bodies, not titles: touch lacks hover and screen readers need no tooltips.

pairs.source: /** 一集只有脚本、还没排视频产物：卡片只能显示条目数本身。 */
pairs.translation: /** Script-only episodes without scheduled video artifacts display entry counts only. */

pairs.source: // 「第二章」「第三章」切自整本源文，按源文位置排列；「番外」自带原文，放在哪里都行。
pairs.translation: // 第二章/第三章 cut whole sources in source order; 番外 owns standalone sources, freely placeable.

pairs.source: // jsdom 不做布局：按条目在列表里的位置给出纵向排开的矩形，键盘拖动才有落点可算。
pairs.translation: // jsdom lacks layout; assign vertically stacked rectangles by list positions for keyboard-drop targets.

pairs.source: // 「番外」移到「第二章」之后
pairs.translation: // Move 番外 after 第二章.

pairs.source: // 上一次移动还在保存：校验与提交仍按旧顺序，叠加的移动会算错落点
pairs.translation: // Prior moves still saving; validation/submission use old order, so overlapping moves calculate wrong targets.

pairs.source: /** 在播出顺序（episodes[] 排列）中的位置，从 1 起；徽标显示它而不是集 ID。 */
pairs.translation: /** One-based broadcast positions from episodes[], displayed instead of IDs. */

pairs.source: /** ad 项目隐藏集语义：徽标不显示播出位置，改用场记板图标。 */
pairs.translation: /** Ads hide episode semantics, using clapboard icons instead of positions. */

pairs.source: /** ep.title 为空时的兜底显示文本（ad 项目用项目标题）。 */
pairs.translation: /** Missing ep.title fallback text, project titles for ads. */

pairs.source: /** 项目生成模式：决定条目数报「分镜数」还是「视频单元数」。必填，漏接线时类型报错而不是静默显示错名词。 */
pairs.translation: /** Required generation modes determine storyboard/video-unit nouns; missing wiring type-errors rather than silently mislabels. */

pairs.source: // 进度按视频产物的可用数算——可用 = current ∪ stale，与工作台同一份计数。
pairs.translation: // Video progress uses current ∪ stale usable artifacts, shared with workbenches.

pairs.source: // 视频总数为 0（尚未成脚本）时退回剧本条目数，只用于显示"这集有几件内容"。
pairs.translation: // Zero video totals before scripts fall back to entry counts, describing content volume only.

pairs.source: // stale 是可用产物，不进缺口计数：单独报一个数说明有几件可以考虑重生。
pairs.translation: // Stale is usable, excluded from gaps; report separately as possible regeneration candidates.

pairs.source: // 汇总该集全部产物类型，与大厅卡片上那一行同口径。
pairs.translation: // Aggregate all artifact kinds per episode, matching lobby cards.

pairs.source: // 会话、任务与项目事件流都走网络，外壳的开合与折叠不依赖它们
pairs.translation: // Sessions, tasks and project event streams use the network; shell opening/collapse does not depend on them.

pairs.source: /** 紧凑档：视口窄于 1280，`(min-width: 80rem)` 不匹配。 */
pairs.translation: /** Compact mode: viewport narrower than 1280; `(min-width: 80rem)` does not match. */

pairs.source: // 临时展开只在当前页面有效
pairs.translation: // Temporary expansion applies only to the current page.

pairs.source: // 进入单集页自动收为图标栏：搜索框随之隐藏，图标栏不能按看不见的搜索词过滤
pairs.translation: // Episode pages automatically collapse to icon rails, hiding search; invisible search terms must not filter icon rails.

pairs.source: // 错误提示另有一份供读屏立即播报的副本
pairs.translation: // Error notices also have immediate screen-reader announcement copies.

pairs.source: // 关闭按钮在指针移入或键盘聚焦提示区后才对读屏开放
pairs.translation: // Close buttons become screen-reader-accessible only after pointer entry/keyboard focus within notices.

pairs.source:
/**
 * 顶栏状态条「下一步」的呈现形状：由项目层制作状态的 `next_action` 与 `next_alternatives` 投影而来，
 * 界面不自行推断下一步。
 *
 * 按钮分三种：`nav` 跳到工作台里能完成这一步的位置；`agent` 把请求预填进 Agent 输入框，由用户确认发送；
 * `ai` 直接提交这一步（目前只有 AI 规划分集）。还没有 Web 直接调用入口的动作只给 `agent`。
 */
/** 状态条右段「下一步」后面的短语。 */
pairs.translation: /** Phrase following Next step in the status bar right segment. */

pairs.source: /** 弹层里的一句说明。 */
pairs.translation: /** One explanatory sentence in the popover. */

pairs.source: /** 是否带附加指令输入框；附加指令只写进交给 Agent 的消息。 */
pairs.translation: /** Whether to include extra-instruction inputs; these instructions enter only messages passed to Agent. */

pairs.source: /** 下一步落在哪一集（集 ID）；项目层动作为 null。 */
pairs.translation: /** Target episode ID for next steps; null for project-level actions. */

pairs.source: /** 下一步动作的祈使短语，与集页面板同一套译文。 */
pairs.translation: /** Imperative next-action phrase, sharing translations with episode panels. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 项目层的下一步。没有下一步（`none`）或项目数据升级失败（由状态条的迁移形态接管）时返回 null。
 * 有分集规划在排队或执行时（`planningActive`），下一步让位给「分集规划进行中」。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Project next steps. Return null for no step (`none`) or project-data upgrade failures (handled by migration status bars).
 * Queued/running episode planning (`planningActive`) replaces next steps with Episode planning in progress.
 */

pairs.source: // 落在某一集的备选（从空白开始、补充集原文等）在集页面板就地给出入口，顶栏不改写成「交给 Agent」
pairs.translation: // Episode alternatives (start from scratch, add episode source, etc.) have local panel entries; headers do not rewrite them as Hand to Agent.

pairs.source: // 短片只有一集：跳到账本里唯一的那一集，不假定它的集 ID。
pairs.translation: // Short films contain one episode: navigate to the sole ledger episode without assuming its ID.

pairs.source: // 缺创作灵感和商品时生成脚本不可做，先去概览页填写，与集页面板的提醒同一去处
pairs.translation: // Missing creative ideas/products prevent script generation: fill these in on overview pages, matching episode-panel reminder destinations.

pairs.source: /** 交给 Agent 的消息：附加指令非空时另起一行附上。 */
pairs.translation: /** Agent messages: append nonempty extra instructions on a new line. */

pairs.source: /** 集的产物里有比当前内容旧的（分镜图或视频）。 */
pairs.translation: /** Episode artifacts include storyboards or videos older than current contents. */

pairs.source: /** 任务状态连续跳变时合并成一次重新求解的窗口（毫秒），与集页面板同一取值。 */
pairs.translation: /** Millisecond task-change merge windows, matching episode panels. */

pairs.source: /** 平的状态面：不内凹、不含凸起亮片，避免读成分段开关。 */
pairs.translation: /** Flat states without inset/raised highlights, avoiding segmented-toggle appearance. */

pairs.source: /** 状态条上的一段：原生按钮，交给 PopoverTrigger 的 render 渲染。 */
pairs.translation: /** Native status buttons rendered through PopoverTrigger render. */

pairs.source: /** 当前所在集页的集 ID；不在集页时为 null。 */
pairs.translation: /** Current episode IDs, null outside episodes. */

pairs.source: /** 项目层的制作状态：随项目快照与本项目任务的变化重新求解。 */
pairs.translation: /** Project production state resolves on snapshots/current-project task changes. */

pairs.source: // 状态求解失败只让右段暂不显示，不打断工作台；下一次快照变化会重试。
pairs.translation: // Failed solves temporarily hide right segments only, preserving workbenches and retrying next snapshots.

pairs.source: /** 15px 进度环，与数字徽标同尺寸。 */
pairs.translation: /** 15px progress rings, matching numeric badges. */

pairs.source: /** 迁移失败：整条变暖色，「重试」直接重跑数据升级链；失败后标题带次数，弹层自动展开原因。 */
pairs.translation: /** Migration failures warm entire bars; Retry reruns upgrades, counts appear in titles and causes expand. */

pairs.source: // 升级已完成；刷新失败时只给刷新失败的提示，不同时报告成功
pairs.translation: // Upgrades completed; failed refreshes notify failure only, without simultaneous success.

pairs.source: /* 顶栏窄时只留图标与「重试」，标题收进无障碍名称与弹层。 */
pairs.translation: /* Narrow headers retain icons/Retry, moving titles into accessible names/overlays. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 顶栏中间的状态条：左段是集进度（点开是逐集清单），右段是项目层的下一步（点开是说明与按钮）。
 * 数据升级失败时整条换成迁移形态；升级有报告且尚未确认过时，旁边多一枚可关闭的升级提示。
 * 只投影后端给出的项目摘要与制作状态，不自行推断下一步。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Center header bars: left episode progress/per-episode overlays, right project next steps/explanations/actions.
 * Upgrade failures replace bars with migration states; unconfirmed reports add dismissible upgrade notices.
 * Project backend summaries/states only, never infer next steps locally.
 */

pairs.source: // 集页上：项目层下一步指向本集时让位给本集面板，不出现两个重复的按钮。
pairs.translation: // When project next steps target current episodes, yield to episode panels rather than duplicate actions.

pairs.source: // 每集都完成且源文没有剩余：右段只陈述「全部完成」，不带动作。广告的左段已写「短片已完成」。
pairs.translation: // All episodes complete without remaining sources: right states All completed without actions; ad left already says Short film completed.

pairs.source: // 面板开着时新到的通知同样不再计入角标，也一并高亮
pairs.translation: // New notices while drawers are open also avoid badges and receive highlights.

pairs.source: // 调宽手柄在文档流里占 1px（分隔线本身）。
pairs.translation: // Resize handles occupy 1px in document flow (the separator itself).

pairs.source:
/**
 * 项目工作区外壳：顶栏横跨全宽，下方是「侧栏 | 画布 | Agent 面板」三栏，三栏之间用调宽手柄分隔。
 *
 * - 外壳是唯一按视口切换档位的地方（1280）。标准档的 Agent 面板挤压画布，画布至少保留 480px；
 *   紧凑档的 Agent 面板是覆盖在画布右侧的非模态层，焦点在面板内时 Esc 收起，侧栏收为图标栏。
 * - 侧栏在单集页与分集视图自动收为图标栏，可临时展开，换页后恢复；离开这些页面后回到用户自己的选择。
 * - Agent 面板的开合与宽度在 `app-store`；收起时内容保持挂载，输入中的文字与会话连接不受影响。
 * - 尺寸容器：侧栏 `@container/sidebar`，画布 `@container/canvas`（宽度查询），Agent 面板
 *   `@container-size/agent`（宽高都可查询，输入框的 `40cqh` 按面板高度计算）。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Project workspace shell: a full-width header above sidebar | canvas | Agent panel columns, separated by resize handles.
 *
 * - Only the shell switches modes by viewport (1280). Standard-mode Agent panels squeeze the canvas, preserving at least 480px;
 *   compact-mode Agent panels are nonmodal overlays on the right of the canvas; Esc collapses them when focused inside, and sidebars become icon rails.
 * - Sidebars automatically collapse on episode pages and episode-list views; temporary expansion resets on page changes, and leaving restores user choices.
 * - Agent panel opening and width live in `app-store`; collapsed contents remain mounted, preserving typed text and session connections.
 * - Size containers: sidebar `@container/sidebar`, canvas `@container/canvas` (width queries), Agent panel
 *   `@container-size/agent` (width/height queries; input `40cqh` is relative to panel height).
 */

pairs.source: // 演示项目在后端不存在：任务 / 项目事件流和 Agent 都是真实写路径，演示态下整条都不接
pairs.translation: // Demo projects do not exist on the backend: tasks/project event streams and Agent are real write paths, all disconnected in demos.

pairs.source: // demoMode 演示→真实切换时先于 store 变为 false，currentProjectName 单独判一次
pairs.translation: // demoMode becomes false before stores during demo→real transitions; separately check currentProjectName

pairs.source: // 兜住这一帧仍读到旧演示项目名的窗口，避免对不存在的演示项目建一次必然失败的 SSE 连接。
pairs.translation: // to cover frames still reading old demo names, avoiding guaranteed-failing SSE connections to nonexistent demo projects.

pairs.source: // useTaskRefresh 的 projectName=null 语义是「不按项目过滤」而非「停用」，enabled 必须
pairs.translation: // useTaskRefresh projectName=null means no project filtering, rather than disabled; enabled must

pairs.source: // 同步这一判定，否则该帧会退化成对全局任务的轮询而非真正停用。
pairs.translation: // mirror this check, otherwise this frame polls global tasks instead of actually disabling refresh.

pairs.source: // 演示面板不可收起，也不覆盖画布：引导后面几步要在画布上高亮
pairs.translation: // Demo panels cannot collapse or cover the canvas: later tour steps highlight canvas elements.

pairs.source: // ---- 侧栏折叠：有自动折叠的原因时默认折叠、可临时展开，原因或页面变化后复位 ----
pairs.translation: // ---- Sidebar collapse: automatic reasons default to collapsed; temporary expansion resets when reasons/pages change ----

pairs.source: // ---- 面板尺寸：开合与折叠由状态驱动面板库，拖动等用户操作的结果再写回状态 ----
pairs.translation: // ---- Panel sizes: state drives library opening/collapse; results of dragging and other user operations return to state ----

pairs.source: // 记住的侧栏宽度只在命令式调宽时读取，不参与渲染，更新时不重绘外壳
pairs.translation: // Remembered sidebar widths are read only for imperative resizing, not rendering; updates do not rerender shells.

pairs.source: // 面板的 defaultSize 是双击手柄复位到的默认宽度；挂载时与之后的开合、折叠都在这里按记住的宽度落到面板上。
pairs.translation: // Panel defaultSize is the double-click reset width; remembered widths are applied here at mount and subsequent opening/collapse.

pairs.source: // 开合时宽度瞬时切换，不做宽度动画：给宽度做动画会让画布逐帧重新排版
pairs.translation: // Opening/collapse changes widths instantly: width animation would relayout the canvas every frame.

pairs.source: // 键盘调宽与双击复位都经库的命令式接口完成，库同步通知布局变化，但不标记为用户操作；
pairs.translation: // Keyboard resizing and double-click resets use imperative library APIs; layout changes notify synchronously without marking user operations;

pairs.source: // 调整期间记下「用户在调宽」，结果就和拖动一样被记住，不会被拉回原来的宽度。
pairs.translation: // mark user resizing during adjustment so results are remembered like dragging, rather than reverting to previous widths.

pairs.source: // 双击由库在 document 的捕获阶段处理，window 的捕获阶段先于它
pairs.translation: // The library handles double-clicks in document capture; window capture runs first.

pairs.source: // 拖动、键盘或双击让库折叠、展开了面板时，同步回开合状态，并记住调出来的宽度
pairs.translation: // When drag, keyboard or double-click operations collapse/expand panels, synchronize opening state and remember resulting widths.

pairs.source: // 其余变化来自视口与档位：库按变化前的百分比缩放面板，或为画布的最小宽度挤窄面板。展开着的面板回到记住的
pairs.translation: // Other changes come from viewport/mode switches: the library scales panels using previous percentages or squeezes them for canvas minimums. Expanded panels return to remembered

pairs.source: // 像素宽度；放不下时库把结果夹在约束内，布局不变也就不会再次触发。
pairs.translation: // pixel widths; when they cannot fit, the library clamps within constraints, and unchanged layouts do not trigger again.

pairs.source: // 覆盖模式下画布按「画布栏 + Agent 面板」的宽度排版，被面板盖住而不是被挤窄
pairs.translation: // Overlay-mode canvases lay out at canvas-column + Agent-panel width, covered by panels instead of squeezed.

pairs.source: // 焦点在面板内时收起面板，焦点回到顶栏的「Agent」开关，不落到页面开头
pairs.translation: // Collapsing focused panels returns focus to header Agent toggles, rather than the page beginning.

pairs.source: // 紧凑档的覆盖层是非模态的：焦点在面板内时 Esc 收起面板。监听挂在 document 的冒泡阶段，面板内的控件先处理自己的 Esc
pairs.translation: // Compact overlays are nonmodal: Esc collapses when focused inside. Listen in document bubble so panel controls handle their own Esc first.

pairs.source: // 只认 DOM 上在面板内的按键；从面板里打开的对话框经 Portal 渲染，按 Esc 关的是对话框
pairs.translation: // Only recognize keys inside panel DOM; dialogs opened there render through Portals, and Esc closes those dialogs.

pairs.source: // 外壳根节点是定位元素，文档本身不滚动；滚动只发生在侧栏、画布与 Agent 面板各自的区域里。
pairs.translation: // Shell roots are positioned; documents do not scroll. Scrolling occurs within separate sidebar, canvas and Agent regions.

pairs.source: // 库在面板内层写死 overflow: auto，只能经 style 覆盖：画布各视图自己滚动；
pairs.translation: // The library hardcodes overflow: auto on inner panels, requiring style overrides; canvas views handle their own scrolling;

pairs.source: // 覆盖模式下画布要伸到 Agent 面板底下，不能被这一层裁掉。
pairs.translation: // overlay canvases extend beneath Agent panels and must not be clipped by this layer.

pairs.source: // eslint-disable-next-line shadcn/no-inline-styles -- 覆盖库写在内层的内联 overflow
pairs.translation: // eslint-disable-next-line shadcn/no-inline-styles -- Override the library inner inline overflow

pairs.source: /* 面板收起时手柄贴在分栏右缘，命中区会伸出外壳，因此隐藏；手柄仍留在 DOM 里并禁用，库就不在这条边界上生成拖动区域 */
pairs.translation: /* Collapsed handles sit at column right edges and their hit areas extend outside shells, so hide them; keep disabled handles in DOM so the library creates no drag region at this boundary. */

pairs.source: // 收起后宽度为 0，内容保持最小宽度挂载在原处、不可见，由这一层裁掉
pairs.translation: // Collapsed width is 0; contents stay mounted at minimum width, invisible in place and clipped by this layer.

pairs.source: // eslint-disable-next-line shadcn/no-inline-styles -- 覆盖库写在内层的内联 overflow
pairs.translation: // eslint-disable-next-line shadcn/no-inline-styles -- Override the library inner inline overflow

pairs.source: /** 侧栏折叠后的图标栏宽度。 */
pairs.translation: /** Sidebar icon-rail width when collapsed. */

pairs.source: /** 标准档 Agent 面板挤压画布时，画布至少保留的宽度；面板与侧栏的可拖上限随之收窄。 */
pairs.translation: /** Minimum canvas width when standard-mode Agent panels squeeze it; panel/sidebar drag limits narrow accordingly. */

pairs.source: /** 调宽手柄每按一次方向键移动的距离。 */
pairs.translation: /** Resize-handle distance per arrow-key press. */

pairs.source: // localStorage 不可用时只保留内存值
pairs.translation: // Keep only in-memory values when localStorage is unavailable.

pairs.source: /** 用户在没有自动折叠的页面上手动选择的折叠状态。 */
pairs.translation: /** User-selected collapse state on pages without automatic collapse. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 侧栏自动折叠为图标栏的原因：紧凑档一律折叠；标准档在单集页（分镜、剪辑）与分集视图折叠。
 * `location` 是工作区嵌套路由内的路径（如 `/episodes/3`）。没有原因时侧栏跟随用户的选择。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Reasons for sidebar icon-rail collapse: always in compact mode; in standard mode on episode pages (storyboard/editing) and episode-list views.
 * `location` is the workspace nested-route path (e.g. `/episodes/3`). Without reasons, follow user choices.
 */

pairs.source: // 外壳是唯一按视口切换标准档与紧凑档的地方，断点与 Tailwind 的 xl 一致。
pairs.translation: // Only shells switch standard/compact modes by viewport; the breakpoint matches Tailwind xl.

pairs.source: // 测试环境没有 matchMedia 时按标准档处理
pairs.translation: // Test environments without matchMedia use standard mode.

pairs.source: /** 视口宽度低于 1280 时为紧凑档：侧栏收为图标栏，Agent 面板改为覆盖画布。 */
pairs.translation: /** Viewports narrower than 1280 use compact mode: sidebar icon rails and Agent panels overlaying canvases. */

pairs.source: /** 顶栏「Agent」开关与 Agent 面板的 DOM id：开关经 aria-controls 指向面板，面板收起时焦点回到开关。 */
pairs.translation: /** DOM IDs of header Agent toggles/panels: aria-controls connects toggles to panels; collapsed-panel focus returns to toggles. */

pairs.source: /** 后端附上的 E1S10 指称：它在第 1 集（无标题）里当前排第 3 位。 */
pairs.translation: /** Backend E1S10 references: currently position 3 in untitled episode 1. */

pairs.source: /** 构成表与筛选行都会出现供应商名，按区块取值才不会撞上 chip 的清除按钮。 */
pairs.translation: /** Providers appear in breakdowns/filter rows; scope queries to avoid chip Clear buttons. */

pairs.source: /** 断言写进 URL 的筛选时按键读，避免依赖 query 串里的键序。 */
pairs.translation: /** Read URL filters by key rather than depending on query-key order. */

pairs.source: // 同一页上的两个成功率走同一个按语言的格式器：vi 的小数点是逗号。
pairs.translation: // Both same-page success rates share localized formatters; vi decimals are commas.

pairs.source: // 端点试跑记录的项目名是空串，它与「不筛项目」不同，键要在但值为空。
pairs.translation: // Endpoint-trial project names are empty strings, distinct from no project filtering; keys remain with empty values.

pairs.source: // 状态不在这条规则要写的三维里，原来选的什么就还是什么。
pairs.translation: // Status is outside the three dimensions written by these rules; preserve previous selections.

pairs.source: // chip 按记录带回的指称称呼分镜：集名与当前位置，不露条目 ID。
pairs.translation: // Chips use record references for storyboards: episode titles/current positions without entry IDs.

pairs.source: // 宫格不是分镜：芯片只给指称标签，不加类型前缀。
pairs.translation: // Grids are not storyboards; chips show reference labels without type prefixes.

pairs.source: /** 构成表的三个维度；模型行按 (provider, model) 分组。 */
pairs.translation: /** Three breakdown dimensions; model rows group by (provider, model). */

pairs.source: /** 成功率低于这条线的行用警示色，扫一眼就能挑出问题行。 */
pairs.translation: /** Rows below this success-rate threshold use warning colors for easy scanning. */

pairs.source: /** 名称列吃掉剩余宽度，三列数字固定宽度。 */
pairs.translation: /** Name columns take remaining width; three numeric columns have fixed widths. */

pairs.source: /** 一行的展示数据；三个维度投影到同一形状后共用渲染。 */
pairs.translation: /** Display-row data; dimensions project into shared shapes/rendering. */

pairs.source: /** 模型行的副标题是它的供应商。 */
pairs.translation: /** Model-row subtitles identify providers. */

pairs.source: /** `other` 行不可点击，它没有对应的筛选值。 */
pairs.translation: /** `other` rows are unclickable without corresponding filter values. */

pairs.source: /* 占比条：宽度是该行调用数占总调用数的比例，经 CSS 变量传入 */
pairs.translation: /* Share bars: row calls/total calls determine widths through CSS variables. */

pairs.source: /** Agent 记录合并成的那一项的名称。 */
pairs.translation: /** Names of merged Agent-record entries. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 三个维度投影成同一行形状。点击写入的筛选按维度不同：模型行同时写供应商，
 * 因为跨供应商的同名模型只有配上供应商才唯一。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Three dimensions project into shared rows. Clicked filter writes depend on dimensions: model rows also write providers,
 * since cross-provider same-named models are unique only with providers.
 */

pairs.source: // 点击在两个视图间切换：Agent 记录只在「Agent 会话」视图里按供应商筛选。
pairs.translation: // Clicks switch views; provider-filtered Agent records appear only in Agent sessions views.

pairs.source: // 取消只撤回模型：供应商是可以单独成立的筛选，留着它由用户自己的 chip 清除。
pairs.translation: // Deselecting clears models only; providers are independently valid filters, cleared by their own chips.

pairs.source: /** 排队中的分镜图任务；后端附上的指称说它在第 1 集里排第 `position` 位。 */
pairs.translation: /** Queued storyboard-image tasks; backend references place them at `position` in episode1. */

pairs.source: /** 分镜筛选值所属集的标题与播出位置，取自已载入的记录；没有时显示未命名集与集内 ID。 */
pairs.translation: /** Storyboard-filter owning episode titles/broadcast positions from loaded records; absent values show Untitled episode/local IDs. */

pairs.source: // 「全部」用 null 表示：项目名可以是空串（端点试跑记录），自定义模型 ID 不受限制，任何字符串哨兵都可能与真实取值相撞。
pairs.translation: // All uses null: project names can be empty (endpoint trials), and custom-model IDs are unrestricted, making all string sentinels collision-prone.

pairs.source: /* 项目标题、供应商名可能很长：下拉可比触发器宽，超过上限的选项截断，悬停看全文 */
pairs.translation: /* Long project/provider names: dropdowns may exceed trigger widths; truncate over-limit options, revealing full text on hover. */

pairs.source: // 选定供应商后只列它的模型：跨供应商的同名模型混在一起既选不准也读不懂。
pairs.translation: // Selected providers restrict model lists; cross-provider duplicate names are otherwise ambiguous/unreadable.

pairs.source: // 分镜没有下拉可选，只由「需要关注」的连续失败条目写入；chip 是它唯一的出口。
pairs.translation: // Storyboards lack selectable dropdowns, set only by Needs attention repeated-failure entries; chips provide their sole clearing exits.

pairs.source: // 只有分镜与视频单元带类型前缀；宫格等其他条目直接用指称标签。
pairs.translation: // Only storyboards/video units have type prefixes; grids/others use reference labels directly.

pairs.source: // 同名模型在不同供应商下各出现一次；下拉只按模型名筛选，去重后列出。
pairs.translation: // Same-named models appear per provider; dropdowns filter model names only, listing deduplicated values.

pairs.source: /* Agent 记录的媒体类型都是文本，筛不出东西；这一维只属于「生成调用」 */
pairs.translation: /* All Agent records are text media, making filters useless; this dimension belongs only to Generation calls. */

pairs.source: // react-doctor-disable-next-line react-doctor/prefer-dynamic-import -- 本模块由 UsageTrendCard 经 lazyNamed 按需加载，recharts 随它进独立 chunk
pairs.translation: // react-doctor-disable-next-line react-doctor/prefer-dynamic-import -- UsageTrendCard lazyNamed loads this module on demand, placing recharts in its separate chunk

pairs.source: /** 柱宽上限与顶端圆角。 */
pairs.translation: /** Bar-width caps/top corner radii. */

pairs.source: /** 图表的可读名称，同时作为表格替代的标题。 */
pairs.translation: /** Human-readable chart names, also alternative-table titles. */

pairs.source: /** 桶的区间文案；按天时是单个日期，按周时是「M/D – M/D」。 */
pairs.translation: /** Bucket-interval copy; daily single dates, weekly M/D – M/D. */

pairs.source: /** 一根柱的数据行：各序列的值按序列 key 展开，另带原桶供提示使用。 */
pairs.translation: /** Bar rows expand series values by keys and retain original buckets for hints. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 按天（或按周）堆叠的柱图。图本身对辅助技术是一张带名字的图片，等价数据由紧随其后的
 * 表格替代承担——屏幕阅读器读表比读柱子的坐标可靠得多。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Daily/weekly stacked bars. Assistive technology sees named images; immediately following tables provide equivalent
 * data, more reliably read by screen readers than bar coordinates.
 */

pairs.source: // 只有最上面一段带圆角；中间段方角，段与段之间不出现缺口。
pairs.translation: // Round only top segments; square middle segments preserve gapless stacks.

pairs.source: /** 只有落库时会拿到 `segment_id` 的任务才在进行中行上挂分镜标签。 */
pairs.translation: /** Only tasks receiving `segment_id` at persistence gain running-row storyboard labels. */

pairs.source: // audio 记账无白名单，resource_id 无条件作 segment_id。
pairs.translation: // audio accounting has no allowlist; resource_id unconditionally becomes segment_id.

pairs.source: // audio 记账无白名单：后端对任何 resource_type 都把 resource_id 记成 segment_id，
pairs.translation: // audio accounting has no allowlist: backends record resource_id as segment_id for every resource_type,

pairs.source: // 前端在这一支上也不该因为资源种类没登记就退回泛化标签。
pairs.translation: // so frontends must not fall back to generic labels for unregistered resource kinds either.

pairs.source: /** 待确认的取消请求。单个取消带级联预览，全部取消带排队中条数。 */
pairs.translation: /** Awaiting-confirmation cancellations; single tasks include cascade previews, Cancel all queued counts. */

pairs.source: /** 确认按钮的在途状态。 */
pairs.translation: /** Confirmation-button pending state. */

pairs.source: /** 上一次确认的取消请求失败；确认态保留，用户可重试。 */
pairs.translation: /** Latest confirmed cancellation failed; retain confirmation for retries. */

pairs.source: /** 服务端拒绝取消时给出的已本地化原因（如任务已开始执行）；网络类失败为 null。 */
pairs.translation: /** Localized server rejection reasons (e.g. tasks already started); null for network failures. */

pairs.source: /** 取消请求在途的任务 id；行内把 × 换成 spinner 用它判定。 */
pairs.translation: /** Task IDs with pending cancellations, replacing inline × with spinners. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 取消任务的两步交互：先取预览、再由 `alertdialog` 二次确认。取消只对排队中的任务开放
 * （ADR 0006）——单个取消预览会被级联取消的排队中下游，全部取消只清排队中、不动执行中。
 *
 * 预览接口在任务已离开可取消状态时报错，此时静默收场：这一行马上会被下一轮任务刷新
 * 改写，弹一个「取消失败」反而让用户以为自己漏点了。确认时任务恰好已开始执行，服务端
 * 以 409 拒绝，确认态展示服务端给出的原因。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Two-step task cancellation: preview, then `alertdialog` confirmation. Queued tasks only
 * (ADR 0006); single previews include queued downstream cascades, while Cancel all clears queued tasks without touching running tasks.
 *
 * Preview errors after tasks leave cancellable states settle silently: next refreshes immediately replace rows,
 * and Cancel failed would imply missed clicks. Tasks starting at confirmation time receive server
 * 409 rejections; confirmations display server reasons.
 */

pairs.source: /** 一次确认会话的状态。gen 在切换作用域或关闭确认时递增，旧会话的异步结果按 gen 丢弃。 */
pairs.translation: /** Confirmation-session states; gen increments on scope switches/closing, discarding old async results by gen. */

pairs.source: // 切换作用域即开启新会话：旧项目的确认态在同一次渲染里消失，旧会话在途请求的结果不再写回
pairs.translation: // Scope switches create sessions: old-project confirmations disappear in the same render, and old pending results cannot write back.

pairs.source: // 只在发起时的会话仍是当前会话时写入
pairs.translation: // Write only while initiating sessions remain current.

pairs.source: // 作废旧作用域在途的预览请求
pairs.translation: // Invalidate pending previews from old scopes.

pairs.source: // 任务已不在可取消状态，或预览被更新的操作接管
pairs.translation: // Tasks no longer cancellable, or previews superseded by newer operations.

pairs.source: // 没有排队中的任务，或预览被更新的操作接管
pairs.translation: // No queued tasks, or previews superseded by newer operations.

pairs.source: // 取消没有落到服务端：确认态留在原地并标记失败，用户看得到原因、也能重试。
pairs.translation: // Cancellations not committed server-side retain failed confirmations, with visible causes/retry.

pairs.source: // 取消已落地，确认态先收起；随后的重取失败是刷新问题，不再算取消失败。
pairs.translation: // Committed cancellations close confirmations first; subsequent refetch failures are refresh problems, never cancellation failures.

pairs.source: // 确认在途时两个按钮都禁用，关闭只发生在没有在途确认时
pairs.translation: // Both buttons disable during confirmation requests; closing occurs only without pending confirmations.

pairs.source: /** 服务端拒绝取消的已本地化原因；为空时显示通用失败文案。 */
pairs.translation: /** Localized server cancellation-rejection reasons; empty means generic failure copy. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 取消确认。行内 `alertdialog`：它属于所在列表的一次操作，弹到屏幕中央会让用户
 * 失去「取消的是哪一行」的上下文。
 *
 * 焦点按行内确认的约定（docs/standards/frontend.md）：打开时落在「返回」上；请求在途时两个按钮
 * 禁用，请求失败、按钮解除禁用后焦点回到「返回」；「返回」或 Esc 退出确认并把焦点交还触发它的元素；焦点离开确认区域
 * 也退出，焦点留在用户去的地方。确认成功后由调用方卸载。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Cancellation confirmation: inline `alertdialog`, belonging to list actions; screen-centered dialogs would lose
 * context about which rows users cancel.
 *
 * Follow inline-confirmation focus rules (docs/standards/frontend.md): initially focus Back; disable both buttons during
 * requests, returning focus to Back when failed requests reenable them. Back/Esc exits and returns focus to triggers; leaving confirmation regions
 * also exits while retaining focus at user destinations. Callers unmount after successful confirmation.
 */

pairs.source: // 预览请求返回前焦点仍在触发取消的按钮上，挂载时记下它，退出确认时交还
pairs.translation: // Focus remains on cancellation triggers before previews return; capture at mount and restore when exiting confirmation.

pairs.source: // 交还焦点会触发区域的 blur，已退出时不再重复退出
pairs.translation: // Focus restoration triggers region blur; never exit twice after already exiting.

pairs.source: // react-doctor-disable-next-line react-doctor/prefer-html-dialog -- 行内非模态确认，留在所在列表里不进顶层；原生 <dialog> 的价值在 showModal 的模态行为，这里不需要
pairs.translation: // react-doctor-disable-next-line react-doctor/prefer-html-dialog -- Inline nonmodal confirmations remain in lists, not top layers; native <dialog> value lies in showModal modality, unnecessary here

pairs.source: // 预览返回前焦点停在触发按钮上
pairs.translation: // Focus remains on triggers until previews return.

pairs.source: /** 供应商模型 Sheet 的地址：自定义供应商的记录写的是 `custom-<id>`。 */
pairs.translation: /** Provider-model Sheet URLs; custom-provider records use `custom-<id>`. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 调用的模型：供应商还在供应商设置里时打开它的 Sheet；Agent 凭证、已删除的自定义供应商、不再内置的旧值与没有供应商的
 * 旧记录只显示模型名。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Called models: open provider Sheets when providers still exist in settings. Agent credentials, deleted custom providers, formerly built-in values and providerless
 * historical records show model names only.
 */

pairs.source: /** 悬停、点按标签或按 Enter/Space 时显示的说明。 */
pairs.translation: /** Explanations on hover, label clicks or Enter/Space. */

pairs.source: /** 从属于上一行的明细（如缓存写入的两档）。 */
pairs.translation: /** Details subordinate to previous rows, e.g. two cache-write tiers. */

pairs.source: /** 项目内相对路径的缩略图；文件已不存在时换成占位，历史记录也能照常打开。 */
pairs.translation: /** Project-relative thumbnails; missing files use placeholders so historical records still open normally. */

pairs.source: // 用量记录引用的图可能已被覆盖或删除，这里没有指纹可用：显式不带版本，走服务端的协商缓存
pairs.translation: // Referenced images may be overwritten/deleted without available fingerprints; explicitly omit versions and use server negotiated caching.

pairs.source: // 记录里的总输入含缓存读写；对外的「输入」只指没有命中也没有写入缓存的那部分。
pairs.translation: // Total input includes cache reads/writes; external Input means only portions neither hitting nor writing caches.

pairs.source: /** 进行中区非空时的兜底轮询间隔；设置页不订阅事件流。 */
pairs.translation: /** Fallback polling interval while running regions are nonempty; settings pages subscribe to no event streams. */

pairs.source: /** 时间范围不作用于进行中区，其余维度同样作用于任务行。 */
pairs.translation: /** Time ranges exclude running regions; other dimensions also apply to task rows. */

pairs.source: // 任务的分镜就是它的资源 id；生成图片、视频、配音的任务都以分镜为目标。
pairs.translation: // Task storyboards are resource IDs; image/video/speech generation tasks all target storyboards.

pairs.source: // 排队中的任务还没解析出模型（model 为 null），按模型筛选时算不匹配。
pairs.translation: // Queued tasks lack resolved models (model=null), so model filters treat them as nonmatches.

pairs.source: // 设置页不挂工作台外壳，需在这里登记任务刷新作用域，直达页面也能看到当前进行中任务。
pairs.translation: // Settings pages lack workbench shells; register task-refresh scopes here so direct navigation still shows current running tasks.

pairs.source: // 打开与筛选变化时取数；URL 是筛选的真相源，刷新后从 URL 恢复走的是同一条路径。
pairs.translation: // Fetch on opening/filter changes; URLs are filter truth, and refresh restoration follows identical paths.

pairs.source: // store 跨挂载常驻，打开那次要连 summary 一起重取，离开期间结束的调用才进 KPI 与图表。
pairs.translation: // Stores persist across mounts; opening refetches summaries too, incorporating calls completed while absent into KPIs/charts.

pairs.source: // 供应商显示名随 summary 由服务端按请求语言渲染；切换语言后只重取 summary，
pairs.translation: // Servers render provider display names with summaries using request languages; language changes refetch summaries only,

pairs.source: // 记录页与分页位置不动。挂载那次的取数由上方筛选 effect 负责。
pairs.translation: // leaving record pages/pagination unchanged. Filter effects above own mount fetching.

pairs.source: // 一律 replace：筛选与详情的每一次微调都压进历史会让「后退」变成逐格倒带。
pairs.translation: // Always replace history: recording every filter/detail adjustment would make Back rewind field by field.

pairs.source: // 进行中区 = 任务 store（有任务的调用）∪ 无任务的 pending 调用，两者不相交。
pairs.translation: // Running regions = task stores (task-backed calls) ∪ taskless pending calls, with no overlap.

pairs.source: // 只看「有没有」进行中行：行数变化（任务陆续入队）不该重置计时器，否则轮询会被一直推迟。
pairs.translation: // Observe only whether running rows exist; changing counts as tasks queue must not reset timers and indefinitely defer polling.

pairs.source: // 进行中行消失意味着一次调用已结束（任务终态或 pending 调用落账），记录表、KPI 与图表
pairs.translation: // Disappearing running rows mean calls ended (terminal tasks/pending calls accounted); refetch entire record tables/KPIs/charts

pairs.source: // 要接住它，整体重取一次。只认同一视图（筛选与页码不变）下的收缩：筛选与翻页引起的
pairs.translation: // to capture them. Recognize contraction only within unchanged views (filters/page numbers); disappearances from filtering/paging

pairs.source: // 消失由各自的取数路径负责。
pairs.translation: // belong to their respective fetch paths.

pairs.source: // 「全部取消」只清排队中，与顶栏悬浮层同一套确认流程。项目未固定时无从取消——
pairs.translation: // Cancel all clears queued tasks only, sharing header-popover confirmation. Unfixed projects cannot cancel because

pairs.source: // 取消接口按项目作用，跨项目一次清空不是这个按钮的语义。
pairs.translation: // APIs operate per project; cross-project clearing is outside this button meaning.

pairs.source: /* 构成与需要关注在内容列够宽时并排，窄时上下叠放；没有需要关注时构成占满整行 */
pairs.translation: /* Breakdown/Needs attention sit alongside when content widths permit, otherwise stack; breakdown fills rows without attention items. */

pairs.source: // URL 直接换 id 时 store 要到 effect 才切换，首帧不能把上一条的正文挂在新标题下。
pairs.translation: // Direct URL-ID changes update stores only in effects; never render previous bodies under new titles on initial frames.

pairs.source: /** 后端附上的条目指称：「雨夜」这一集里排第 `position` 位的分镜。 */
pairs.translation: /** Backend entry references: storyboard at `position` in episode “雨夜”. */

pairs.source: // 项目名不占位置：悬浮层里整栏都属于同一个项目。
pairs.translation: // Project names occupy no space; entire popovers belong to single projects.

pairs.source: // 位置角标叠在缩略图上、不截断；集名与正文摘录放不下时才截断。
pairs.translation: // Positional badges overlay thumbnails without truncating; only trailing episode titles/body excerpts truncate when necessary.

pairs.source: // 条目已不在剧本里：写「已删除」，不回退成条目 ID。
pairs.translation: // Entries absent from scripts show Deleted, never fallback IDs.

pairs.source: // 宫格不按位置指称，仍以集内 ID 开头。
pairs.translation: // Non-positional grids still begin with episode-local IDs.

pairs.source:
/**
 * 记录行的视图模型。已结束的调用与尚未产生调用行的进行中任务都投影到这里，
 * 让记录表、进行中子块与顶栏悬浮层共用同一个行组件。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Record-row view models project both completed calls and running tasks without call rows,
 * sharing row components across tables/running subsections/header popovers.
 */

pairs.source: /** React key；进行中的任务行没有记录 id，用任务 id 组键。 */
pairs.translation: /** React keys; running tasks lack record IDs and use task-ID-derived keys. */

pairs.source: /** 可打开详情的行才有记录 id；进行中的任务行为 null。 */
pairs.translation: /** Only detail-openable rows have record IDs; running tasks use null. */

pairs.source: /** 服务了任务的调用带任务 id；无任务的文本调用与端点试跑为 null。 */
pairs.translation: /** Task-backed calls carry task IDs; taskless text calls/endpoint trials use null. */

pairs.source: /** 端点试跑记录为空串。 */
pairs.translation: /** Endpoint trials use empty strings. */

pairs.source: /** 项目标题；没有时界面回退到项目名。进行中的任务行没有标题。 */
pairs.translation: /** Project titles, falling back to names in UI; running tasks lack titles. */

pairs.source: /** 排队中的任务模型尚未解析时为 null，界面显示「待解析」。 */
pairs.translation: /** Queued unresolved models are null, displayed as Pending resolution. */

pairs.source: /** segmentId 所属集的标题与播出位置，界面据此显示「标题 · S01」。 */
pairs.translation: /** segmentId owning episode titles/broadcast positions, displayed as Title · S01. */

pairs.source: /** 已结束调用的开始时刻；进行中行用它排序与计时。 */
pairs.translation: /** Start times of completed calls; running rows use them for sorting/timing. */

pairs.source: /** null 表示未定价；0 是定价为零。 */
pairs.translation: /** null means unpriced, 0 means zero-priced. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 任务的后端资源类型。记账侧一律用复数桶名，`image_edit` 的单数 `resource_type` 亦在
 * 执行时转成同一套桶名（`server/services/tasks/image_edit_tasks.py` 的
 * `edit_version_resource_type`），故两条来源共用这一张表。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Task backend resource types. Accounting always uses plural buckets; singular `image_edit` `resource_type` values also
 * convert during execution into the same buckets (`server/services/tasks/image_edit_tasks.py`
 * `edit_version_resource_type`), so both sources share this table.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 可作 `segment_id` 的资源类型，与后端 `lib/generation/media_generator.py` 的
 * `segment_id_for` 白名单同口径；audio 无白名单，无条件透传。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Resource types usable as `segment_id`, matching backend `lib/generation/media_generator.py`
 * `segment_id_for` allowlists; audio has no allowlist and passes through unconditionally.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 进行中任务行的分镜标签口径。任务结束后落库的记录行按后端 `segment_id_for` 判定
 * `segment_id`，进行中的行在这里用同一份白名单判定，免得角色 / 道具 / 场景图任务
 * 进行中显示「分镜 <名字>」、结束后又变回泛化的目标类型。
 */
// audio 记账不看 resource_type，任务的资源种类有没有登记在这一支上都不影响结论。
pairs.translation: // audio accounting ignores resource_type; registration of task resource kinds in this branch never changes conclusions.

pairs.source:
/**
 * 进行中的任务投影成记录行。任务侧没有模型与调用行，模型留空由界面显示「待解析」；
 * 计时起点取 `started_at`，尚未开始时取 `queued_at`。本地渲染任务（`render`）不调用
 * 供应商、不记用量，没有对应的行，返回 null。
 */

/**
 * 进行中区按开始时刻倒序：最近排队或启动的排在最前。任务与调用两侧的时间戳未必带
 * 同样的时区后缀，故按解析出的时刻比较，不按字符串。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Running regions sort newest start first, including recently queued/started tasks. Task/call timestamps may use different
 * timezone suffixes, so compare parsed instants rather than strings.
 */

pairs.source: /** 媒体类型的字形与色调：`iconClass` 给图标着色，`swatchClass` 给色块，`color` 供图表填充，三者是同一个 `--media-*` token。 */
pairs.translation: /** Media glyphs/tones: `iconClass` colors icons, `swatchClass` swatches, `color` chart fills; all share `--media-*` tokens. */

pairs.source: /** 无值时的占位。 */
pairs.translation: /** Missing-value placeholders. */

pairs.source: /** 状态文字与状态点的颜色。 */
pairs.translation: /** Status wording/status-dot colors. */

pairs.source: /** 有翻译的失败短语。列表只显示短语，原始报错只在详情里显示。 */
pairs.translation: /** Translated failure phrases; lists show phrases only and details raw errors. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 目标列拆成两段：分镜号（集内 ID）作为不截断的前缀，集名在后、放不下时截断。
 * 没有分镜的调用按用途显示，前缀为空。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Two-part targets: storyboard numbers (episode-local IDs) as untruncated prefixes, then episode titles truncated if necessary.
 * Calls without storyboards show uses with empty prefixes.
 */

pairs.source: /** 在本集里的当前位置；条目已不在剧本里时为 null。 */
pairs.translation: /** Current episode positions; null when no longer scripted. */

pairs.source: /** 分镜或视频单元：以位置、缩略图与正文摘录指认。 */
pairs.translation: /** Storyboards/video units identified by positions, thumbnails and body excerpts. */

pairs.source: /** 不按位置指称的条目（宫格）的集内 ID。 */
pairs.translation: /** Episode-local IDs of non-positional entries (grids). */

pairs.source: // 带集前缀却没有指称：集已移出账本，集名用「未命名集」；条目随集一起不在了，显示「已删除」。
pairs.translation: // Episode prefixes without references mean episodes left ledgers; show Untitled episode and Deleted because entries left with episodes.

pairs.source: /** 供应商显示名优先取筛选候选值里的 label，查不到回退 id。 */
pairs.translation: /** Prefer provider filter-candidate labels; unresolved providers fall back to IDs. */

pairs.source: /** 未定价原因码 → 文案 key；码来自后端 `UnpricedReason`，不认识的码回落到通用说明。 */
pairs.translation: /** Unpriced reason codes → copy keys; backend `UnpricedReason` codes unknown here use generic explanations. */

pairs.source: /** 汇总里只有项目名，标题从 `filter_options.project_titles` 查。 */
pairs.translation: /** Summaries contain project names only; look up titles in `filter_options.project_titles`. */

pairs.source: /** i18n 语言码 → Intl locale；两者不同名，故显式映射，未知语言回落英文。 */
pairs.translation: /** i18n language codes → Intl locales; names differ, requiring explicit maps; unknown languages fall back to English. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 成功率与失败率共用的百分比渲染，KPI 条、构成表、趋势 tooltip、悬浮层同走这一处：
 * 同一个数在同一页出现多次，格式必须一致。分母为 0 时后端给 null，显示破折号。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Shared success/failure percentage formatting across KPI bars/breakdowns/trend tooltips/popovers:
 * repeated same-page values must format identically. Zero denominators yield backend null, displayed as dashes.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 计数的千分位按界面语言渲染。设置页 KPI 条与悬浮层 KPI 行共用，与 `formatRatio` 同走
 * `intlLocale`：一行里的调用次数与成功率必须是一套分隔习惯，`toLocaleString()` 跟的是
 * 浏览器语言。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Count grouping follows UI languages. Settings/popover KPIs share `intlLocale` with `formatRatio`:
 * call counts/success rates within rows must use consistent separators, while `toLocaleString()` follows
 * browser languages.
 */
/** Fixed decimals trimmed of trailing zeros: 12.0 → 12, 12.34 → 12.3. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * token 数量带单位的紧凑写法，单位写在值里（如「12.3 万 token」）。中文按「万」「亿」进位，
 * 其余语言走 Intl 的紧凑记数（12.3K tokens）；不足一万（千）的原样写出，带千分位。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Compact token counts include units in values (e.g. 12.3 万 token). Chinese increments by 万/亿,
 * other languages use Intl compact notation (12.3K tokens); below ten thousand/thousand, use plain grouped counts.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 日历日 `YYYY-MM-DD` 按当前语言渲染。这个日期是后端算好的本地日，不是时刻，故按
 * 本地时区构造 Date——交给 `new Date(string)` 会当成 UTC 午夜，东西半球各挪一天。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Render calendar `YYYY-MM-DD` dates in UI languages. These are backend-computed local days, not instants, so construct
 * local-timezone Dates; `new Date(string)` would interpret UTC midnight, shifting days across hemispheres.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 已删除项目的记录改挂到墓碑名 `<项目名>#deleted-<UTC 时刻>`（见 `lib/db/repositories/project_records.py`），
 * 与同名新项目分开。界面显示原名与删除日期，筛选仍用墓碑名原值。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Deleted-project records reattach to tombstone names `<项目名>#deleted-<UTC 时刻>` (see `lib/db/repositories/project_records.py`),
 * separate from new same-named projects. UI shows original names/deletion dates; filters retain raw tombstone names.
 */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 用量页的项目显示名：有标题显示标题；没有标题（项目已删除、读不到或未设标题）时回退到项目名，
 * 已删除的项目显示原名与删除日期；端点试跑的记录没有项目，给「未命名」。
 */
/** 耗时列；无时长可显示时给破折号。文案与任务读数共用 `formatElapsedMs`。 */
pairs.translation: /** Duration columns show dashes without available durations; copy shares task-readout `formatElapsedMs`. */

pairs.source: /** 进行中行的实时耗时，起点为 ISO 时刻。 */
pairs.translation: /** Live running-row durations, starting at ISO instants. */

pairs.source: /** 会话请求失败：不渲染空态，失败提示由区块统一给出。 */
pairs.translation: /** Failed session requests omit empty states; sections own failure notices. */

pairs.source: /** 无值时的占位。 */
pairs.translation: /** Missing-value placeholders. */

pairs.source: /** 带说明的文字：悬停、点按或按 Enter/Space 时显示说明。 */
pairs.translation: /** Explanatory text revealed through hover, clicks or Enter/Space. */

pairs.source: /** 已定价部分的合计：按币种分别写出；全是 0 元时写 0，没有任何已定价记录时写破折号。 */
pairs.translation: /** Priced subtotals by currency; all-zero totals show 0, no priced records show dashes. */

pairs.source: /* 列表刷新后最近一轮的时间变了，明细随之重取 */
pairs.translation: /* List refreshes change latest-turn times, refetching details. */

pairs.source: /** 展开的会话明细：按时间每条记录一行，同一轮的几条记录自然排在一起。 */
pairs.translation: /** Expanded session details: chronological rows per record naturally group records within turns. */

pairs.source: // 记录里的总输入含缓存读写；对外的「输入」只指没有命中也没有写入缓存的那部分。
pairs.translation: // Total input includes cache reads/writes; external Input means only portions neither hitting nor writing caches.

pairs.source: // 数值断言等待真实图表渲染，不把冷 chunk 的加载耗时算进查询等待。
pairs.translation: // Numeric assertions await actual charts, excluding cold-chunk loading from query waits.

pairs.source: // tooltip 与无障碍表格里，调用次数紧挨着按界面语言渲染的成功率；跟浏览器语言的
pairs.translation: // In tooltips/accessible tables, call counts sit beside localized success rates; browser-language

pairs.source: // `toLocaleString()` 会让同一处出现两种分隔习惯。
pairs.translation: // `toLocaleString()` would mix separator conventions at the same location.

pairs.source: // 成功列与合计列各一个：两处都是同一个格式器的输出。
pairs.translation: // Success/total columns each have one value, both from identical formatters.

pairs.source: // 表头 + 两个日桶。
pairs.translation: // Headers plus two daily buckets.

pairs.source: // 主币种 CNY 之外的 $4.59 不折算也不上图，只在脚注里说明。
pairs.translation: // Nonprimary $4.59 is neither converted nor charted, only footnoted alongside primary CNY.
// 95 days merge into 14 buckets; headers plus 14 rows.

pairs.source: /** `table` 是设置页记录表的一行；`compact` 供顶栏悬浮层复用，两行排布且不显示项目。 */
pairs.translation: /** `table` means settings record-table rows; `compact` is reused by header popovers, with two lines and no projects. */

pairs.source: /** 记录的项目显示名；只有表格布局在显示项目列时用到。 */
pairs.translation: /** Record project display names, used only when table layouts show project columns. */

pairs.source: /** 筛选已固定某个项目时隐藏项目列，避免整列重复同一个值。 */
pairs.translation: /** Hide project columns under fixed-project filters, avoiding entire columns repeating values. */

pairs.source: /** 行尾的额外动作（取消、重试下载），取代默认的「详情」。 */
pairs.translation: /** Additional row-end actions (cancel/retry downloads), replacing default Details. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 目标：分镜或视频单元以位置角标与缩略图开头、不截断，后面的集名与正文摘录在放不下时截断；
 * 宫格这类条目以集内 ID 开头；其余记录只写用途。
 */
/** 状态只放状态与失败短语；没有短语的失败只写「失败」，原始报错在详情里看。 */
pairs.translation: /** States contain statuses/failure phrases only; failures without phrases say Failed, with raw errors in details. */

pairs.source: /** 进行中行订阅秒级时钟；已定格的耗时是静态文本，不为它每秒重渲染。 */
pairs.translation: /** Running rows subscribe to second clocks; frozen durations remain static without per-second rerenders. */

pairs.source: /** 进行中的调用还没结算，显示破折号；未定价与 0 元是两件事，分别显示「未定价」和 0。 */
pairs.translation: /** Unsettled running calls show dashes; unpriced differs from zero cost, showing Unpriced and 0 respectively. */

pairs.source: // 可打开详情时整行是按钮，行内截断的文字不再单独进入 Tab 顺序。
pairs.translation: // Detail-openable rows are entire buttons; nested truncated text no longer separately enters Tab order.

pairs.source: /** 取当前语言的 dashboard 取词器，行为与组件里的 `useTranslation("dashboard")` 一致。 */
pairs.translation: /** Current-language dashboard translators, matching component `useTranslation("dashboard")` behavior. */

pairs.source: // vi 用逗号作小数点；固定的 `90.3%` 在越南语界面里与按语言渲染的 KPI 对不上。
pairs.translation: // vi uses comma decimals; fixed `90.3%` contradicts localized Vietnamese KPIs.

pairs.source: // vi 用点作千分位；`toLocaleString()` 跟浏览器语言，会在越南语界面里给出 `12,340`。
pairs.translation: // vi uses grouping periods; browser-language `toLocaleString()` would show `12,340` in Vietnamese UIs.

pairs.source: // `new Date("2026-02-14")` 是 UTC 午夜，东八区渲染出来会是 14 日、西五区是 13 日。
pairs.translation: // `new Date("2026-02-14")` is UTC midnight, rendering day 14 in UTC+8 and 13 in UTC-5.

pairs.source: // 记录行的耗时与任务读数共用 `common:elapsed_*`：同一段时长全站只有一种写法，
pairs.translation: // Record/task durations share `common:elapsed_*`, ensuring one sitewide duration representation,

pairs.source: // 且超过一小时后给时分而不是「90 分 0 秒」。
pairs.translation: // and hours/minutes rather than 90 minutes 0 seconds beyond one hour.

pairs.source: // 已删除的项目读不到标题，回退到原名与删除日期。
pairs.translation: // Deleted projects lack readable titles, falling back to original names/deletion dates.

pairs.source:
/**
 * 顶栏入口挂在订阅项目事件流的工作台里；两者一起渲染，断言的是「事件到达后重新取数」
 * 这条端到端行为，而不是 hook 内部调了谁。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Header entries mount in project-stream-subscribing workbenches. Render both to assert end-to-end refetch after events,
 * never which functions hooks call internally.
 */

pairs.source: // 首个快照是建连，不是重连；此后每个快照都意味着断过一次线。
pairs.translation: // Initial snapshots establish connections, not reconnections; every later snapshot follows a disconnect.

pairs.source: // Agent 记录都是文本，媒体类型下拉不再出现
pairs.translation: // Agent records are all text; hide media-type dropdowns.

pairs.source: // 表头 + 两条记录
pairs.translation: // Headers plus two records.

pairs.source: // 「输入」不含缓存命中与缓存写入的部分：1000 - 600 - 100 - 50
pairs.translation: // Input excludes cache hits/writes:1000-600-100-50.

pairs.source: // 原因放在悬停提示里
pairs.translation: // Reasons live in hover explanations.

pairs.source: // 进行中区的取数不带时间范围，只有记录表的那一次返回行。
pairs.translation: // Running-region fetches omit time ranges; only record-table requests return rows.

pairs.source: // 标题以位置角标开头，后接集名与正文摘录，不露条目 ID。
pairs.translation: // Titles start with positional badges, followed by episode titles/body excerpts without entry IDs.

pairs.source: // 记录里的总输入 1000 含缓存命中 600 与缓存写入 150，「输入」只剩没缓存的 250。
pairs.translation: // Total input 1000 includes 600 cache hits/150 cache writes, leaving 250 uncached Input.

pairs.source: // 输入与产出两组都无数据：显示「无记录」而不是消失或报错。
pairs.translation: // Both input/output groups lack data: show No records instead of disappearing/errors.

pairs.source: /** 趋势图的两种指标：调用次数按结果堆叠，参考费用按媒体类型堆叠。 */
pairs.translation: /** Two trend metrics: call counts stack by outcome, reference costs by media type. */

pairs.source: /** 日桶多于这个数就把相邻若干天并成一桶，否则一天一桶。 */
pairs.translation: /** Above this daily-bucket count, merge consecutive days; otherwise one day per bucket. */

pairs.source: /** 合并时一桶覆盖的天数。 */
pairs.translation: /** Days per merged bucket. */

pairs.source: /** 堆叠顺序：费用视图从下往上按图片、音频、视频、文本。 */
pairs.translation: /** Cost stacking bottom-to-top: image, audio, video, text. */

pairs.source: /** 一根柱；按天分桶时 `from` 与 `to` 相同，`days` 为 1。 */
pairs.translation: /** Bars; daily buckets have identical `from`/`to` and `days` 1. */

pairs.source: /** 桶内第一天，本地日 `YYYY-MM-DD`。 */
pairs.translation: /** First bucket days, local `YYYY-MM-DD`. */

pairs.source: /** 只含主币种金额，其余币种不折算也不混入。 */
pairs.translation: /** Primary currency only; never convert/mix other currencies. */

pairs.source:
/**
 * 日桶铺成柱。点数超过上限时从最新一天往回每 7 天并一桶——最右一桶恒是完整一周，
 * 不足一周的余数落在最早那桶，图的右端才不会因为「今天还没过完」而矮一截。
 */
pairs.translation:
/**
 * Daily buckets form bars. Above point limits, merge backward from latest days into 7-day buckets; rightmost buckets always cover full weeks,
